title.en: Helicopter Flight in Dubai

overview: Admire spectacular views of Dubai on a 15- or 25-minute shared helicopter flight. With an experienced pilot at the controls, settle into a 5-passenger helicopter and soar above the Palm Jumeirah, Burj Al-Arab and other top sights. Hover around the Burj Khalifa; glide over The World, the man-made archipelago in the Persian Gulf shaped like a map; and snap photos as your pilot points out the main landmarks. Hotel pickup and drop-off are included on your tour.
highlights: 15- or 25-minute helicopter flight in Dubai
Listen to a comprehensive safety briefing before taking to the skies
Soar over Palm Jumeirah, one of Dubai’s impressive artificial archipelagos
See attractions such as Burj Al-Arab hotel and Burj Khalifa, one of the world’s tallest skyscrapers
Fly about The World, an archipelago where ‘countries’ are up for private residential sale
expect: After pickup from your central Dubai hotel, travel to the Atlantis on the Palm Jumeirah to arrive at least 45 minutes before your flight start time.
Check in at the helipad and settle into the comfortable lounge. Sip on a complimentary soda, tea or coffee as you listen to a safety briefing, and when the time comes, meet your experienced pilot.

Soar over the coastline and drink in the sight of the Palm Jumeirah, the incredible Burj Khalifa and the Burj Al-Arab hotel. Hover above the golden beaches and azure waters of the gulf, and have your camera poised as your pilot points out particular high-rises and attractions.
Then, keep your camera ready as you head out over the sea to The World, the stunning man- made archipelago shaped to resemble a world map.
Gaze down at the 300 or so sandy islets below and identify the different countries and continents, such as Lebanon and Greenland, as your pilot tells you about their private and hotelier owners.
After your 15-minute flight, touch back down at the Atlantis helipad and end your helicopter tour with a hotel drop-off.

Alternatively, if you’ve upgraded to a 25-minute flight, enjoy an extra 10 minutes in the air. Fly over other areas of Dubai for bird’s-eye views of more of the city’s attractions. Then, return to the helipad and end your tour with a drop-off at your hotel.
included: Hotel pick up and drop off

title.en: Dubai Hot Air Balloon Flight

overview: Witness a beautiful desert sunrise from the air on a 1-hour hot air balloon Dubai experience. Rise early, travel by air- conditioned minibus to the launch site, and board your shared balloon basket with a professional pilot. Then, glide into the sky and waft over the billowing dunes, gullies and sands of the Dubai Desert Conservation Reservation. Admire the tranquil desert in the pink and golden glow of sunrise, and watch for gazelles and other wildlife below. A refreshing drink and personalized flight certificate to take home provide the finishing touches.
highlights: Dubai desert hot air balloon ride including a drink
Soar over the desert plains and canyons of Dubai Desert Conservation Range
Watch the sun rise over the desert, and see camels and gazelles roaming freely
Receive a personalized flight certificate and enjoy a cool drink after landing
Enjoy a convenient hotel pickup and drop-off service from select Dubai hotels
expect: Wake early and begin your hot air balloon Dubai experience with a pickup from your Dubai hotel or central meeting point.
Hop inside your air-conditioned minibus and travel to the Dubai Desert Conservation Reservation outside the city.
After a roughly 30-minute drive, arrive at the launch site and watch as your beautiful hot air balloon is inflated for your flight.

Listen to a safety briefing, climb inside the basket with an experienced pilot at the controls, and feel your adrenaline race as your balloon drifts gently upward. Each basket holds up to 24 passengers and there’s plenty of space for you to sightsee as you fly. As you rise higher, marvel at the awesome sunrise views and hear interesting commentary from your pilot about the geology and wildlife of the protected Dubai Desert Conservation Reservation.

Soar over the sand dunes, cliffs and barren landscapes; snap photos to capture the shifting colors and shadows of the dawn; and watch for roaming animals such as gazelle and camels. After your approximately 1-hour flight, enjoy a smooth touchdown controlled by your pilot and step back on to solid ground.

Head inside the launch center to enjoy a complimentary drink and receive a personalized flight certificate as a memento. If you wish, buy a professional video of your flight (own expense) so you can relive it at home.
Afterward, return to your minibus and end your hot air balloon Dubai experience with a hotel drop-off.

title.en: Dubai Helicopter Tour

overview: Discover Dubai, the fastest-growing city in the world, from the air on this 12-minute helicopter tour. Beginning from Dubai Festival City and continuing along Dubai Creek through the suburbs, explore this fascinating city, with its impressive skyline and luxurious hotels. See the world's tallest building, Burj Khalifa, located next the one of the world's largest shopping malls. See the wind towers, beaches, golf courses and much more. Light refreshments and onboard commentary included.
highlights: Discover Dubai from the air on this helicopter tour
Listen to the onboard commentary about the many sites below
Enjoy fantastic aerial views
See the world’s tallest building, Burj Khalifa
Tour is offered multiple times throughout the day
Perfect introduction for first-time visitors
Light refreshments provided
expect: Take off towards the Dubai Creek and experience a memoir of the past with the sceneries of the "sails" of the Creek Golf Club, Spice Souk, the Historical Wind Towers and Sheikh Rashid Palace in Heritage Village. Fly above the astonishing Dubai Beaches and be mesmerized with the iconic Burj Al Arab hotel at a distance. Eastwards, be adorned with the views of the amazing architectural masterpiece- Burj Khalifa - the tallest building in the world. Return towards Festival City with unforgettable memories of Dubai and its Heritage.

title.en: Dubai Combo: Helicopter Flight and City Tour

overview: Check out the sights of Dubai by helicopter and coach on this memorable half-day combo! Take a thrilling 15-minute helicopter flight to behold aerial views of Dubai’s top landmarks, from the incredible Burj Khalifa to The Palm and The World archipelagos. Later the same day, enjoy a 5-hour city tour with an informative guide. Traveling between the sites by comfortable coach, stop for photos at the monumental Atlantis, The Palm hotel and Burj Al-Arab, and visit Jumeirah Mosque and Dubai Museum to learn about the city’s historical and modern-day culture.
highlights: Half-day Dubai combo tour including helicopter flight and city tour
Soar above the city and admire views of sleek skyscrapers and the Persian Gulf
Enjoy aerial sights of top Dubai attractions including Burj Khalifa, Burj Al-Arab and
The World
Get to know Dubai on afternoon sightseeing tour by coach with an onboard guide
Explore the luxurious archipelago of Palm Jumeirah and learn about the city’s cosmopolitan culture
Visit Jumeirah Mosque and Dubai Museum in Al-Fahidi Fort
expect: Dubai Helicopter Flight (15 minutes):

Travel independently to the Atlantis, The Palm hotel, on the palm tree-shaped The Palm archipelago at Jumeirah. Check in for your shared flight, get a safety briefing, and climb aboard your state-of-the-art helicopter. Settle into your comfortable seat — either next to the pilot or in the four seats to the rear — and thrill as your helicopter whirrs up into the sky. Make out the fronds and trunk of The Palm below and soar past the skyscrapers of downtown Dubai as your pilot identifies the main landmarks. Ogle the Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest building, and gaze down at the striking Burj Al-Arab hotel, rising like a billowing sail from an islet off Jumeirah Beach. Then, head over the Arabian Gulf to The World, a group of artificial sandy islands built in the shape of a world map. Take snaps of the island ‘countries’ below and then soar back to the Atlantis. After touching down here, make your own way back to your Dubai hotel, where your city tour begins in the afternoon of the same day. City Tour (5 hours): Start your 5-hour tour with an afternoon pickup from your central Dubai hotel. Meet your guide, hop inside your air-conditioned coach and set off to discover Dubai’s highlights. As you travel, hear about Dubai’s rise from fishing port to cosmopolitan city on the back of the discovery of oil in the 1950s and 1960s. Learn about the city’s heritage and the futuristic architecture that has made it one of the world’s most glamorous destinations. Drive past the swanky villas of The Palm archipelago and pose for photos outside its crowning glory: the gigantic Atlantis, The Palm hotel. Stop again for photos at the Burj Al- Arab, and then visit Jumeirah Mosque — one of only a handful of local mosques open to non- Muslims.

Admire the lavish interior, and then continue to Dubai Museum, set inside 18th-century Al Fahidi Fort. With your guide, stroll around the artifacts and displays, including a traditional dhow (Arabic sail boat) and replica souk and Bedouin camp. After exploring here, your tour comes to an end with a drop-off at your hotel.
included: Hotel pickup and drop-off (city tour only)

title.en: Abu Dhabi Seaplane Flight from Dubai Including Ferrari World and Return Transfer

overview: Fly from Dubai to Abu Dhabi on a seaplane and enjoy entry to Ferrari World on this 6-hour experience. Board a shared Cessna seaplane with an experienced pilot, and soar over Dubai and southward to Abu Dhabi’s Yas Island. Enjoy aerial views of Dubai’s Burj Khalifa and World Islands, and the spectacular Yas Viceroy hotel, F1 Grand Prix Circuit and Ferrari World on Yas Island. Land on the water, and after free time for lunch, enjoy the rides and attractions at Ferrari World before a return road transfer to Dubai.
highlights: 45-minute seaplane flight from Dubai to Abu Dhabi
Fly across the sparkling coastline of the Arabian Gulf
Soar above Palm Jumeirah and World Islands
Enjoy views of the F1 Grand Prix and Yas Viceroy Abu Dhabi Hotel from above
Gain free entry to the Ferrari World theme park
Enjoy the rides and attractions as you wish
expect: Travel independently to the Dubai Creek Golf and Yacht Club. Meet your professional pilot and settle aboard your shared Cessna aircraft.
After a safety briefing, thrill as your plane takes off from the water and enjoy the bird’s-eye views as you soar above Dubai.
Marvel at the glittering Burj Khalifa, the world’s highest building; and see the Palm Jumeirah and sail-shaped Burj Al-Arab rising from the sea.
Fly over The World, the artificial islets shaped like a world map, and trace the coast toward Abu Dhabi.
Swoop over the spectacular Yas Marina F1 Grand Prix Circuit, the futuristic Yas Viceroy Abu Dhabi hotel, and the shining red Ferrari World complex.
Then, snap pictures of Yas Island as you fly over the mangrove-lined shores and splash down safely at Yas Marina.

Here, after free time for lunch (own expense) at one of the marina’s restaurants, enjoy a convenient transfer to nearby Ferrari World, the world’s biggest indoor theme park. Show your entrance ticket and experience the attractions independently. Ride the high-speed Formula Rossa coaster, enjoy the racing simulators and travel through the virtual Ferrari factory. Relax at a restaurant (own expense) and browse the Ferrari-themed stores. After around three hours, return to Dubai by road where your tour ends in central Deira.

title.en: Dubai Combo: Helicopter Flight and Desert Camp Experience by 4x4

overview: Combine a helicopter flight over Dubai with an action-packed desert adventure in one day on this memorable combo experience. Board a state-of-the-art helicopter and soar over top Dubai attractions such as The Palm, Burj Khalifa and The World archipelago during an exhilarating 15-minute flight. In the afternoon, ride a 4x4 to a desert camp and experience a host of evening desert activities, including a dune drive, camel ride, henna tattoo session and more. Then, as darkness falls, finish with a delicious barbecue dinner and hypnotic belly dancing show.
highlights: Dubai helicopter and desert camp combo tour, in one day
Soar over the city to ogle views of Dubai’s urban landscape and the Persian Gulf
Enjoy bird’s-eye views of incredible city landmarks such as Burj Al-Arab and Burj
Khalifa
Explore the desert that surrounds Dubai by 4x4 vehicle, driven by a local guide
Spend an evening at a Bedouin-inspired desert camp and try riding a camel
Watch a belly dancing show as the sun sets while enjoying a BBQ dinner
expect: Travel independently to the Atlantis, The Palm hotel, located on The Palm archipelago at Jumeirah. Check in for your shared, 15-minute flight and settle inside your state-of-the-art helicopter — either next to the pilot or in the four seats at the back. Then, after a safety briefing, enjoy the ascent as your helicopter hovers up into the skies above Dubai. Soar along the Jumeirah coastline past the skyscrapers of downtown Dubai and gaze down at The Palm, the artificial island that resembles the shape of a palm tree, as your pilot points out the most notable landmarks.

Swoop toward the Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest building, and absorb the aerial views of the sail-shaped Burj Al-Arab hotel, rising from an island off Jumeirah Beach. Keep your camera poised as you fly over the Arabian Gulf toward The World — the man- made archipelago that’s made up of some 300 sandy islands shaped like a world map. Have fun identifying the different ‘countries’ below and then whirr back to The Palm to return to the heliport.

After landing, make your own way back to your Dubai hotel, from where the next part of your combo tour begins in the afternoon. After an afternoon pickup from your central Dubai hotel, board your comfortable, air-conditioned 4x4, and cruise into the desert that surrounds the city.

Soak in the sandy landscapes and dunes as you travel, and after an exciting dune drive, arrive at a Bedouin-style camp in the heart of the desert. Leave your 4x4 and enjoy an evening of fun-filled desert activities. Climb aboard a camel for a short ride across the sands; get an intricate henna tattoo painted on your hands or feet; and if you wish, have a puff or two on an Arabic shisha water pipe. As the sun sinks below the dunes, dig into a scrumptious barbecue dinner of dishes such as hummus, lamb chops and lentil curry. See the Itinerary for a sample menu. During your meal, enjoy the live entertainment in the shape of an exotic belly dancing show. Lastly, ride back to Dubai by 4x4 and end your experience with a hotel drop-off. Itinerary Sample Menu:

title.en: Dubai Seaplane Flight

overview: Experience spectacular views of Dubai’s skyscrapers, beaches and architectural wonders on a 40-minute seaplane flight. Step aboard a state-of-the-art Cessna seaplane and thrill as you swoop around top Dubai attractions such as the Burj Khalifa, Burj Al-Arab and palm-shaped island archipelago of the Palm Jumeirah. Continue your flight over The World to see how its islands mark out countries and continents from above, and fly over Jebel Ali, Dubai Marina and other landmarks. Choose from two takeoff locations and three departure times from each to suit your schedule.
highlights: 40-minute seaplane flight with transport from central Dubai
Take off from the sea, and then soar through Dubai's skies
Admire aerial views of prestigious developments such as Burj Khalifa, one of the world's tallest skyscrapers
Glide over Dubai’s man-made archipelagos including Palm Jumeirah and The World
See Dubai Marina and the busy ports of Jebel Ali and Port Rashid
Choose one of four start times to suit your schedule
expect: Choose from two take-off locations — Jebel Ali or Dubai Creek — and select from the three departure times at each location when you book. Then, make your own way to the takeoff point for your 40-minute seaplane flight.
Meet your professional pilot and admire your aircraft: a modern Cessna seaplane that takes off from and lands on water.

Get a safety briefing and take a seat inside the shared plane. Put on your seatbelt and feel your heart lift as your plane gathers speed on the water and rises above the Dubai coastline. Have your camera ready as you soar around the Burj Khalifa and sail-shaped Burj Al-Arab hotel. Snap photos of the palm-tree-shaped archipelago of the Palm Jumeirah; and look down on The World, the stunning 300 or so sandy islands built in the outline of a world map. Swoop over Port Rashid and hover above Dubai Creek and the Deira and Bur Dubai neighborhoods as your pilot points out the landmarks.

Then, glide over the skyscrapers and luxury yachts of Dubai Marina, and circle the golden beaches, golf courses and ships and cranes of the Jebel Ali port area. Finally, thrill as your Cessna turns and glides back along the coast toward Jumeirah and Dubai.
After roughly 40 minutes in the air, land safely on the water and say goodbye to your pilot. Your seaplane experience then ends at the original start point.

title.en: Hot Air Balloon and Breakfast Safari From Dubai

overview: Treat yourself to a spectacular desert experience with a morning hot air balloon ride from Dubai. Look down on the endless landscape of sand while you’re up in the air, and watch for native wildlife like camels and gazelles. Back on the ground, travel by vintage Land Rover to a private reserve for breakfast.
highlights: Dubai hot air balloon ride
Soar above the Arabian Desert at sunrise
Look for camels and other local wildlife
Enjoy a breakfast of gourmet dishes such as caviar or smoked salmon
expect: Catch the rising sun at 4,000 feet on an airborne adventure, viewing the vast expanse of golden sand dunes from the comfort of a gentle Hot-air balloon ride. See roaming camels, galloping gazelles and the mighty Arabian Oryx in their natural habitat. Let some of the world's most experienced Pilots take you on a ride of a lifetime. Once you land, you will be driven to a private desert conservation reserve where you will have the chance to freshen up at clean, private bathrooms. Breakfast will be a scrumptious selection of delicacies such as hand-cut smoked salmon and caviar. Then head out into the conservation reserve in museum quality, open top 1950's Land Rovers. These iconic vehicles were the first vehicles ever to traverse the desert 6 decades ago. With an experienced Guide at the wheel, set off through the beautiful Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, a protected haven for desert wildlife. As you rumble through the sands, look for wildlife such as Arabian gazelles and oryx.
The perfect way to see the Dubai desert from above and below.

title.en: Dubai Sunrise Seaplane Flight Including Dubai Creek Abra Boat Ride and City Sightseeing

overview: Fly above Dubai’s futuristic skyline and explore some top Dubai attractions on this 5-hour morning seaplane flight and city tour. Board a comfortable Cessna seaplane just after sun-up and swoop over Dubai landmarks such as the sail-shaped Burj Al-Arab, The World archipelago and more. Then, cruise along Dubai Creek to visit the colorful Spice Souk and Gold Souk, before riding a traditional ‘abra’ boat across the water to explore Dubai Museum and the atmospheric Bastakiya quarter. Numbers are limited to nine people for a more personalized experience.
highlights: Early morning small-group seaplane flight and Dubai city tour with an expert guide
Enjoy a thrilling 25-minute seaplane flight over Dubai, with a water takeoff and landing
Soar over The World archipelago, Burj Al-Arab, The Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Creek
Ride a modern water taxi and traditional wooden abra on Dubai Creek
Visit the Spice Souk, Gold Souk and Dubai's Women’s Museum
Explore Dubai Museum, the Textile Souk and traditional Al Bastakiya, with its windtower-topped houses
Enjoy personalized attention from a guide on a small-group tour limited to nine people
expect: Travel independently to the seaplane jetty at Jebel Ali in the early morning, and settle into your shared, 9-passenger Cessna aircraft. Listen to a safety briefing and feel the excitement as your plane rises up from the water for your 25-minute flight. Enjoy the aerial views of Dubai’s skyline and sparkling Arabian Gulf. Climb to up to 1,500 feet (457 meters) and swoop around Dubai’s landmarks, including the sail-shaped Burj Al- Arab hotel and Palm Jumeirah.

Fly further out to sea to gaze down at The World, the stunning artificial archipelago of islands designed to resemble a map of the world. Then, soar back to the coast and snap photos of the ribbon-like Dubai Creek, before enjoying a smooth landing on the water. Leave your plane and enjoy a short cruise along Dubai Creek on a modern water taxi. Refuel with complimentary tea and coffee as you cruise, and hear interesting commentary on the passing sights from your guide.

Step ashore in the Deira quarter and visit the Spice Souk. Explore the stalls piled with aromatic spices and herbs, and then swing by the Gold Souk. Meander past the gold and jewelry stores and perhaps snap up some goodies (own expense) to take home. Call at Dubai’s Women’s Museum to chart the changing role of women in the UAE, and afterward, board a traditional abra exclusively reserved for your small group to ride across Dubai Creek.
Admire the dhows — traditional Arabic trading boats — on the waters and go ashore at Bur Dubai, on the southern bank of the creek.

Here, visit Dubai Museum, housed in the 18th-century Al Fahidi Fort. Trace Dubai’s incredible transformation from fishing port to cosmopolitan city, and peek inside the nearby Textile Souk, noisy with vendors hawking bright-hued silks.
Lastly, stroll around Bastakiya, Dubai’s oldest quarter, to see its winding lanes and wind- tower houses, and round off your explorations with an included tea and coffee in this charming district.
Afterward, choose to leave your guide here so you can explore independently, or end your tour with a drop-off at Dubai Mall.
Please note: A minimum of two people per booking is required.
included: Admission to Dubai Museum and Dubai's Women's Museum

title.en: Abu Dhabi Discovery Tour and Seaplane Experience Back to Dubai

overview: Discover Abu Dhabi’s highlights and enjoy a return seaplane flight back to Dubai on this 5-hour combo tour. Leave Dubai by road for Abu Dhabi, the United Arab Emirates’ capital city, and visit the majestic Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque. Sip an indulgent gold flake-sprinkled cappuccino at the Emirates Palace hotel, and see landmarks including the Corniche and Qasr Al Hosn Fort. Return to Dubai by seaplane, soaring over the Burj Al-Arab, World islands and Burj Khalifa. Numbers are limited to nine for a more personalized experience.
highlights: 5-hour trip from Dubai to Abu Dhabi, including a city tour and return seaplane flight
Visit Abu Dhabi's palatial Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and see Al Bateen, the city's oldest quarter
Sip a cappuccino sprinkled in 24-carat gold flakes at the glamorous Emirates Palace hote
Take in top Abu Dhabi attractions including the Corniche and Qasr Al Hosn Fort
Enjoy a 45-minute seaplane flight back to Dubai, taking off from the waters of Yas
Marina
Absorb incredible aerial views of Dubai’s Burj Khalifa, World Archipelago and other icons
Small-group tour with a maximum of nine people for a more intimate experience
expect: After a smooth drive from Dubai, your tour will commence with a visit to the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque. This architectural marvel is the largest mosque in the UAE and can welcome 40,000 worshipers. It features 82 domes, over a 1,000 columns, 24 carat gold gilded chandeliers, and the world's largest hand knotted carpet. The main prayer hall is dominated by one of the world’s largest chandeliers – 32 feet (10 m) in diameter, 49 feet (15 m) in height, and weighing twelve tons. Reflective pools surround the mosque, amplifying its beauty. The 96 columns in the main prayer hall are clad with marble and inlaid with mother of pearl, one of the few places where you will see this craftsmanship.

Then the tour will pass by the area of Al Bateen, which was the first populated area in Abu Dhabi, to reach another architectural marvel – the Emirates Palace Hotel. The Palace is the essence of palatial, yet traditional Arabic architecture and is one of the most inspiring hotels in Abu Dhabi with 114 breath-taking 60 foot-high (18 m) domes, ornate hotel rooms, and luxury suites decorated in gold and marble. It is fitting, then, to drink the signature gold coffee here. Also known as the Palace Cappuccino, this superior blend of aromatic coffee is sprinkled with gold flakes to give you a taste of royalty, making it unlike anything you have ever tried before. Served on a polished silver tray, you can enjoy your cappuccino with a special dates and dark chocolate Then, proceed to Heritage Village, passing by Corniche beach road to reach Qasr Al Hosn Fort which is Abu Dhabi’s symbolic birthplace. Qasr al Hosn began life in the 1760s as a coral and sea stone watchtower, with a commanding position overlooking the sea, later transformed into an impenetrable fort. Due to the shells’ reflective effect, the fort’s walls would sparkle in the sun offering a welcome coastal navigational tool for the region’s merchants. Mangrove was chosen to make the flooring and roof structure due to its natural strength and durability. In the 1950s, an iconic palace enclosed the initial fort and it was transformed into a museum and repository of collections relating to Abu Dhabi and the Gulf. Take a short drive to the seaplane jetty at Yas Marina to settle into your shared, 9-passenger Cessna aircraft. Listen to a safety briefing and feel the excitement as your plane rises up from the water for your flight back to Dubai. Enjoy the aerial views of Abu Dhabi’s skyline and sparkling Arabian Gulf. Climb to up to 1,500 feet (457 meters) and return back to Dubai with great views of the sail-shaped Burj Al-Arab Hotel, Palm Jumeirah, the World Islands, and Burj Khalifa, before landing at historic Dubai Creek.

title.en: Dubai and The World Seaplane Flight

overview: Admire The World archipelago from above on this 40-minute seaplane flight from Dubai. Board a 9-passenger seaplane at Dubai Creek, and feel the thrill of a water take-off before soaring above top Dubai attractions such as the Burj Khalifa, Burj Al-Arab hotel and other highlights. Then, fly over the Arabian Gulf to take in the The World, the sandy archipelago designed like a world map. Recognize the different countries laid out below, and then touch down on the sea off the islands before a scenic boat transfer back to Dubai.
highlights: 40-minute seaplane flight over Dubai and The World archipelago
Experience a thrilling water takeoff from Dubai Creek and land on the Arabian Gulf
Soak up bird's-eye views of iconic Dubai sights like the Burj Khalifa, Palm Island and
Burj Al-Arab
Fly over The World and spot the continents and countries the islands form
Come ashore at The World and enjoy a scenic 25-minute boat ride to The Palm
expect: Travel independently to the seaplane jetty at Dubai Creek, the waterway that snakes through Dubai’s center. Listen to a safety briefing from the experienced pilot, and settle into your shared, 9-passenger light aircraft for your approximately 40-minute flight. Then, enjoy the water take-off as your seaplane rises above Dubai’s towering skyline. Marvel at the skyscrapers and beaches below, and view sights such as the multi-lane Sheikh Zayed Road and breathtaking Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest building. Trace the coastline to Dubai Marina, and circle the sail-shaped Burj Al-Arab hotel and The Palm archipelago. Then, fly further out to sea to The World, a cluster of some 300 man-made islands located roughly 2.5 miles (4 km) from the coast.

As you fly, hear fun facts about the sandy islets and how they’re designed to resemble a world map. Gaze down from above and identify the main countries they represent, with help from your pilot. Then, after around 40 minutes in the air, come down to land in the waters off the archipelago. Step ashore on to an island, bid goodbye to your pilot, and enjoy a scenic boat ride to The Palm, just off the coast at Jumeirah in Dubai.

Take snaps of Jumeirah’s high-rises from the water, and after leaving your boat, enjoy an included, air-conditioned transfer to Dubai Mall, one of the world’s largest shopping malls. Your experience concludes at the mall, leaving you free to enjoy its shops and attractions on your own.

title.en: Overnight Safari and Sunrise Hot-Air Balloon Ride

overview: Camping, a wildlife safari, dinner under the stars and a hot air balloon ride—it’s all part of this overnight desert experience from Dubai. Travel across the sand by vintage Land Rover to look for animals like gazelles and oryx, and stop at a Bedouin-style safari camp. In the morning, soar above the Arabian Desert in a balloon to watch the sunrise.
highlights: Overnight desert experience from Dubai
Go in search of native wildlife like camels on a safari
Enjoy desert activities such as smoking a shisha pipe or getting a henna tattoo
Camp under the starry night sky
Witness the sunrise on a hot air balloon ride
expect: Day 1 - Vintage Land Rover Safari and Overnight Camping
Start your overnight experience with pickup at your Dubai hotel, and travel into the desert aboard an open-roof vintage Land Rover, a mode of transport used extensively in 1950s desert expeditions.

As you travel, listen to your guide’s stories about Dubai past and present, as well as the many customs and traditions that you’ll experience throughout the evening. Head through Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve on an African-style wildlife safari, looking for Arabian gazelles and oryx; then stop in a Bedouin-inspired camp in the grounds of a private royal retreat. Pose in the sand dunes for a photo as the sun goes down, gaze at the UAE’s national bird – the falcon – during a falconry display. Make your way past the gently flickering flames from the lights that mark the entrance way, and hop out of your Land Rover to take a seat at your shared table. Before your meal starts, a range of cultural activities are demonstrated. Enjoy an Arabic coffee and sit back to watch dancers perform to traditional Emirati music, or perhaps get a henna tattoo, smoke a shisha pipe (Arabic water pipe) or even try the traditional mode of Bedouin transport — a camel. Then, all that’s left to do is to feast on your 4-course dinner under the stars. Like the activities at the camp, the dishes are mostly traditional Emirati specialties, combining flavors from the Middle East.

After dinner, sit around the bonfire and gaze up at the stars, and then make your way to your Arabic tent, complete with comfortable mattress, pillows and blanket, nestled inside the camp. Settle in and enjoy sleeping in the heart of the desert!
Day 2 - Hot-Air Balloon

Since you are only minutes from the take off site, wake up later than passengers coming all the way from Dubai. Once you arrive, you will receive a safety briefing before climbing inside the basket of the balloon with an experienced pilot at the controls. Feel your adrenaline race as you drift upward. Each basket holds up to 24 passengers and there’s plenty of space for you to sightsee as you fly.

As you rise higher, marvel at the awesome sunrise views and hear interesting commentary from your pilot about the geology and wildlife of the protected Dubai Desert Conservation Reservation while you watch for roaming animals such as gazelle and camels. After your approximately 1-hour flight, enjoy a smooth touchdown controlled by your pilot and step back on to solid ground.

Upon landing, enjoy a complimentary drink and receive a personalized flight certificate as a memento. If you wish, buy a professional video of your flight (own expense) so you can relive the experience at home.
Afterward, return to your minibus and end your once in a lifetime Dubai experience with a hotel drop-off.

title.en: Dubai RIB Boat Cruise: Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina

overview: Zip and zoom along Dubai’s most spectacular stretch of coast on an exciting 1.5-hour cruise by RIB (rigid-inflatable boat). Step aboard your high-speed craft at Dubai Marina, and hold the rails as your skipper opens the throttle and speeds you over the waves. Thrill as you whizz around the man-made archipelago of Palm Jumeirah, and enjoy unobstructed views of the Palm Atlantis, Burj Al-Arab, royal palaces and Dubai Lagoon from the sea. This RIB cruise is limited to a maximum of 10 people, so you enjoy a more personalized experience.

Hang on tight as a skipper navigates the motor-powered inflatable boat

Cruise out of the marina and leave the skyscrapers behind as your boat zips through the waves to the spectacular Palm Jumeirah.

Designed in the shape of a palm tree with a central ‘trunk’ and ‘fronds’, the island chain is lined with upscale villas and hotels perched beside the shimmering Persian Gulf. Bounce through the waters to the Palm’s showstopper sight: the gargantuan Atlantis The Palm. This vast hotel towers up from the Palm’s outer fringes and is best appreciated from the water.
After taking photos here, cruise toward the impressive Burj Al-Arab, the sail-shaped hotel on an artificial island just off Jumeirah beach.
Speed around the hotel, and enjoy the last thrilling stretch of the cruise as you zoom past royal palaces and Dubai Lagoon to Dubai Marina, where your 1.5-hour trip ends.

overview: Zip around the Palm Jumeirah and The World archipelagos by speedboat on a thrilling 2-hour cruise from Dubai. Gaze at the colossal Atlantis The Palm hotel and speed further out to sea to The World, with its artificial islets designed to resemble different countries. Then, enjoy the cooling coastal winds as the fittingly named Sea Breeze gathers speed, reaching up to 40 miles (64 km) per hour.

Cut through the waves and keep refreshed with the unlimited complimentary water and sodas on board. Grab your camera and snap photos of the Palm Jumeirah as your skipper steers toward the beautiful, man-made archipelago. Designed in the shape of a palm tree, each curving frond of the island is lined with expensive villas and residential complexes overlooking the water.

Jet around the different fronds and keep your camera poised as you reach the outer fringes of the Palm — home to the monumental Atlantis The Palm. Snap pictures of the stunning hotel that dominates the archipelago.

Afterward, head further to the east to visit The World, the 300 or so man-made sandy islets shaped like a world map. Admire the still-unfinished archipelago as your skipper points out the different countries and continents they represent.

Revel in the views of Dubai’s skyscrapers stretched along the coast and pause off the sail- shaped Burj Al-Arab hotel that rises from the sea just off Jumeirah beach. Finally, jet around the Palm once more and dock at the marina. Your experience concludes with a hotel drop-off.

expect: Begin with a pickup from your Dubai hotel and hop inside your air-conditioned minivan. Then, enjoy the views as you drive to Musandam, a mountainous area of Oman on the northeast tip of the Arabian Peninsula.

Arrive in the town of Dibba, and board a double-decker Omani dhow for your cruise. Then, feast your eyes on the views as you sail along the untouched Musandam coast. Ogle the towering mountains, sea grottos and cliffs, and drift past steep-sided Zighy Bay and the secluded, palm-lined beaches of the fishing village of Haffa. As you sail, polish your tan on the sun deck or relax on a cool, shaded deck, keeping your eyes peeled for dolphins playing in the waters. Stay refreshed with the unlimited sodas, waters, tea and coffee available on board. Stop for a swim in the crystalline seas or use the supplied snorkeling equipment to discover the underwater world — the clarity of Musandam’s waters makes it a snorkeler’s dream. Afterward, sit down to a delicious, onboard Arabian-style buffet lunch. Dishes may vary, but expect barbecued chicken, green salads, hummus (chickpea dip), pasta and more. Following lunch, your skipper will drop anchor again so you can swim and snorkel more. Plunge into the cool waters or, alternatively, just soak up the natural beauty around you to the gentle sound of the lapping waves.
After your 5.5-hour cruise, dock back at Dibba and make your return journey to Dubai, where your trip ends at your hotel.

title.en: Alexandra Dhow Cruise in Dubai Marina

overview: Explore the waterways of Dubai Marina on this 2-hour, sightseeing dinner cruise. Climb aboard the ‘Dhow Alexandra,’ a wooden Arabic Ship that has been refurbished and renovated into a high-class floating restaurant operating in Dubai Marina. The Dhow Cruise Dinner has become one of the most popular tourist attractions in the city. Enjoy a buffet dinner with five salads, seven main-course dishes, a seafood soup and four dessert options, plus entertainment and a spectacular view of the city skyline from the water
highlights: Take a sightseeing dinner cruise in Dubai

expect: A “Dhow” is a traditional wooden vessel that is common in the Middle East and has been used historically for a variety of purposes, primarily for trading. Dhows are made in a variety of sizes and in the UAE have been most used for trade between UAE and Iran aswell as for pearl diving. Arabian Dhow Cruise with dinner on board is considered to be the most romantic trip, especially our new trip along the Dubai Marina – the most fascinating landscape in Dubai. “Alexandra” is a 120 Foot Traditional Arabic ‘Dhow’ that has been refurbished into a quality floating restaurant. Dinner includes international buffet and unlimited soft drinks. Take a seat and listen to your guide’s entertaining commentary as you explore some of Dubai’s top sights by land. Hear how Dubai rose from a fishing port to wealthy metropolis in just a few decades following the discovery of oil in the 1950s and 1960s. Have your camera ready as you explore one of the city’s oldest neighborhoods, Bur Dubai. Snap photos of the traditional wind-towered houses and pass Shindagha Heritage Village — a recreation of Dubai’s original fishing settlement — and the Shindagha Tower, one of the city’s two old defensive watchtowers.

After seeing the sights on land, get ready for splash down as your vehicle enters the waters of Dubai Creek. Then, with your bus now transformed into a boat, relax as you cruise past the Gold Souk, Spice Souk and other sights such as the Grand Mosque and Deira Twin Towers. After 30 minutes on the water, step back on dry land and bid goodbye to your guide, bringing your experience to an end.

expect: Begin your desert experience with a pickup from central Dubai hotel. Enjoy the views as you travel into the desert and swap your pickup vehicle for a shared, open-top vintage Land Rover. If you wish, upgrade when you book to travel in your own private Land Rover, with a private driver.

Take a seat in the rugged 4x4 — a classic vehicle used extensively for desert transport during the 1950s and 1960s. Then, with an experienced driver at the wheel, set off through the beautiful Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, a protected haven for desert wildlife. On route, listen to interesting stories about Dubai’s history and an introduction to the traditional desert activities on offer this evening. As you rumble through the sands, look for wildlife such as Arabian gazelles and oryx. Then, as the sun sets, stop for a fascinating display of falconry. Watch fascinated as the magnificent birds soar through the air and swoop for lures.

Back aboard your Land Rover, drive to a Bedouin-style desert camp in the grounds of a private royal retreat. Admire the beautiful setting of plush tents and outdoor cushions cast in the flickering light of flame torches.

Before dinner, enjoy an array of Emirati activities. Savor an Arabic coffee, watch a bread- making demonstration, get a henna tattoo and take a camel ride. Next, take a seat at a shared, low Bedouin-style table for a delicious 4-course dinner of Emirati specialities. See the Itinerary for a sample menu.
Afterward, smoke a shisha (Arabic water pipe) if you wish, and enjoy displays of Arabic folk dancing and music as the stars light up the sky.

expect: Begin your experience with a pickup from your central Dubai hotel. Settle inside your air- conditioned minivan and relax as travel into the desert.

Meet your camel convoy and enjoy a 45-minute ride on a camel. Enjoy the views as your camel lumbers across the sands: you’ll soon understand how these hardy herbivores provide ideal transport for nomadic Bedouins.
After around 45 minutes, arrive at a Bedouin-style camp inside a desert retreat owned by the UAE royal family.

Leave your camel and absorb the magical setting. The compound stands amid rolling dunes and is prettily illuminated by flame torches, giving it a truly Arabian feel. As the sun sets, watch a display of the ancient sport of falconry. Admire the speed and elegance of the falcons as they answer their handlers’ commands and swoop for lures. Stroll into the dunes for photos of the sunset and enjoy a range of traditional desert activities inside a rustic-style Arabian tent. Savor Arabic coffee, get a henna tattoo and learn to make Arabic breads with a step-by-step demonstration.
Next, settle at a low Bedouin table for a 4-course feast of typical Emirati dishes with sodas and mineral water. See the Itinerary for a sample menu.

title.en: Overnight Desert Camp Experience: Dinner, Emirati Activities and Vintage Land Rover Transport from Dubai

overview: Make like a Bedouin on this overnight experience from Dubai. Take a wildlife-spotting drive around the dunes of the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve by open-top vintage Land Rover to watch for animals such as oryx and gazelles. Then, head for a royal retreat and enjoy an evening of traditional Emirati activities, including falconry displays, camel rides, cooking demonstrations and a scrumptious 4-course dinner. After sleeping in a Bedouin-style tent, wake to a delicious outdoor breakfast before returning to Dubai.
Highlights
Overnight desert experience with dinner with transport by Vintage Land Rover
Look out for wildlife while traveling through Dubai Desert Conservation Reservation
Eat and sleep at a Bedouin-inspired camp in the grounds of a Royal Retreat in the desert
See a bread-making demonstration, falconry display, traditional dancing and more
Feast on four courses of traditional Emirati cuisine while sitting under the stars
Sleep overnight in a comfortable Arabic tent with full bedding and enjoy a traditional breakfast the next morning
expect: Spend a memorable night in the Dubai desert on this overnight tour. Enjoy a wildlife- watching drive by classic Land Rover at the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve followed by an evening of desert entertainments, dinner by the campfire and breakfast the next morning, all at a beautiful outdoor camp. The tour includes round-trip transport and accommodation in an Arabic tent, with a comfortable mattress, pillow and blanket. Itinerary
Day 1: Dubai – Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve (D)

Start your overnight experience with a pickup from your Dubai hotel, and then travel into the desert aboard your open-roof vintage Land Rover, a mode of transport used extensively in 1950s desert expeditions.

As you travel, listen to your guide’s stories about Dubai past and present, as well as the many customs and traditions that you’ll experience throughout the evening. Head through Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve on an Africian-style wildlife safari, looking out for Arabian gazelles and oryx, and then stop in a Bedouin-inspired camp in the grounds of a private royal retreat.

Make your way past the gently flickering flames from the lights that mark the entranceway, and then hop out of your Land Rover to take a seat at your shared table. Before your meal starts, a range of cultural activities are demonstrated around the tables. Enjoy an Arabic coffee and sit back to watch flamboyant dancers performing to traditional Emirati music, or perhaps take a wander around the camp.

Pose in the sand dunes for a photo as the sun goes down, watch a bread-making demonstration or gaze at UAE’s national bird – the falcon – during a falconry display. If you want to immerse yourself in the culture even more, why not get a henna tattoo, smoke a shisha pipe (Arabic water pipe) or even try the traditional mode of Bedouin transport — a camel. Take a seat back at your table in time for a cookery demonstration, where you’ll learn how to make local bread. Then, all that’s left to do is to feast on your 4-course dinner under the stars. Like the activities at the camp, the dishes are mostly traditional Emirati specialties, combining flavors from the Middle East and Asia.

After your meal, sit around the bonfire and gaze up at the stars, and then make your way to your Arabic tent — complete with comfortable mattress, pillows and blanket — nestled inside the camp. Settle in and enjoy sleeping overnight in the heart of the desert! Overnight: Arabic camp in the desert
Day 2: Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve – Dubai (B)

Wake to a beautiful sunrise in the morning and to the scent of strong Arabic coffee brewing and to see your breakfast being cooked. Then, feast on traditional breakfast bread with balaleet (sweet noodles) and chabaab (pancakes), washed down with Arabic coffee, of course You will also hear fascinating tales first-hand from a local Bedouin who will be joining you for breakfast. After your flight or breakfast, meet your driver and bid your friends in the desert camp a fond farewell before traveling back to Dubai. Then, finish your experience with a drop-off at your hotel mid-morning.

title.en: Dubai Culture Tour: Deira Gold Souk and Bur Dubai Village

overview: Discover Dubai’s history and modern-day culture on this 4-hour tour, with an informative local guide. In Deira, visit the glittering Gold Souk and learn about women in UAE society at the Women’s Museum. Then, ride an 'abra' water taxi across Dubai Creek to Bur Dubai to chart the city’s rise from fishing port to futuristic metropolis at Dubai Museum. After sampling some classic Emirati snacks, swap Dubai past for Dubai present as you ride the metro to see two icons of today’s city — The Dubai Mall and dazzling Burj Khalifa
highlights: 4-hour tour through Deira’s Gold Souq and the Bur Dubai Village in Dubai, led by an expert guide
Visit the Bait Al Banat Women’s Museum and haggle for bargains at Deira’s ancient
Gold Souk

Gaze up in awe at Burj Khalifa — one of the world’s tallest towers
expect: Meet your guide in Deira, one of Dubai’s oldest quarters, in the early evening. Then, set off on your 4-hour tour to delve into Dubai’s historical heritage and modern-day life. Hear a fascinating insight into Dubai past and present from your local guide, and start with a visit to the Women’s Museum at Bait Al Banat. Step inside and chart the role of women in the UAE down the ages through the interesting collections of photographs, documents and traditional dress.

Next, head for the Gold Souk, Dubai’s best-known and most popular souk. Meander through the narrow, covered lanes that house some 300 gold and jewelry outlets and, if you wish, snap up some of the great-value wares (own expense) along the way. Then, ride a traditional abra boat across the waters of Dubai Creek. Soak up the views of Deira’s landmarks as you sail, and step ashore at Bur Dubai, on the south bank of the creek. Take a stroll through the bustling textile souk, Dubai’s oldest market, and pay a visit to Dubai Museum, set inside the beautifully preserved, 18th-century Al Fahidi Fort. Walk around the exhibits that chronicle Dubai’s history and its lightning-speed rise from fishing port to wealthy metropolis.
After learning about Dubai’s history here, take a break to sample some traditional Emirati snacks. Be ready to eat with your hands in true local style — it’s all part of the authentic experience!

Then, take a ride on Dubai’s state-of-the-art metro network to witness the height of 21st- century Dubai. Visit The Dubai Mall, one of the world’s largest shopping malls and an iconic symbol of today’s city. Be dazzled by the mall and take a break to enjoy a local sweet treat and cup of refreshing Arabic coffee.
Finish on a high note, with a photo stop outside the soaring Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest building and another emblem of modern Dubai. After taking snaps, your tour comes to a close here.

overview: Explore Dubai's vast Arabian desert while visiting Dubai port. Take a seat and enjoy some reviving Arabic tea, coffee and dates as you ask local experts anything you wish about Emirati life, architecture and culture. Afterward, travel to the bustling Gold Souk in Deira. See the glittering gold, silver and jewelry outlets crammed into the maze-like lanes, and pay a visit to the nearby Women’s Museum. Admire the art, exhibits and multimedia displays, and learn how women have helped to shape Emirati society, culture and arts down the centuries. expect: We begin our tour with the visit to the iconic Al Noor Mosque (Mosque of Lights), the most magnicent out of nearly 600 mosques. It’s currently the only mosque in Sharjah to open its doors to non-Muslims.

title.en: Private Tour: Abu Dhabi Sightseeing with Transport from Dubai

overview: Discover the top tourist attractions in Abu Dhabi on this private full-day trip to the UAE’s glittering capital from Dubai. Traveling to Abu Dhabi from Dubai by comfortable minivan, enjoy ample time to get to know this modern city of glass skyscrapers, mosques, museums and malls. Learn about Abu Dhabi’s past and visit must-sees such as the Sheikh Zayed Mosque, Abu Dhabi Heritage Village and a dhow shipyard. Let your private guide know if there’s anything else you want to see: the itinerary is customizable to suit your preferences.
highlights: Full-day Abu Dhabi city tour with a private guide
Visit Sheikh Zayed Bin Sultan Al-Nahyan Mosque, Abu Dhabi’s grand mosque
Explore Abu Dhabi Heritage Village and see a recreated Bedouin camp
Enjoy a flexible itinerary with personalized attention from a private guide
expect: After morning pickup from your central Dubai hotel, hop inside your comfortable, air- conditioned minivan with your informative private guide. Then, set off on your private day trip to Abu Dhabi, roughly 1.5 hours away.

As you travel, listen as your guide shares interesting facts about the city. Learn how it grew from a humble trading port into one of the world’s most cosmopolitan cities in just a few decades following the discovery of oil in the 1950s. If there’s anything you want to see more or less of during your tour, simply let your guide know. Because your tour is private, the itinerary can be tailored around you.

On arrival, travel around the sights in comfort and stop for photos and to visit the attractions as and when you wish. Make your first stop at the Sheikh Zayed Bin Sultan Al-Nahyan Mosque, otherwise known as the Grand Mosque. Admire the gleaming white domes and minarets, and view the ornate interiors as you learn how the mosque accommodates 40,000 worshippers, making it one of the world’s largest.
Drive along the beautiful, palm-lined Corniche, and after time out for lunch (own expense), visit the Abu Dhabi Heritage Village, an outdoor museum that recreates a traditional oasis village.
Stroll around the replica souks, courtyard houses and Bedouin tents to gain insight into daily life in the region before oil, and browse the interesting craft workshops and stalls for souvenirs.

Finally, see a dhow-making yard where craftspeople build these traditional Arabian wooden boats. Admire some of the work and learn more about the time-honored techniques used to construct these beautiful vessels.
Afterward, relax on your ride back to Dubai where your trip ends with a hotel drop-off.

Travel by coach to Abu Dhabi to visit the state-of-the-art, Ferrari-themed attraction — the world’s largest indoor theme park — to enjoy its rides and entertainments at leisure. Ride the hair-raising Formula Rossa coaster; speed around the go-karting track; take a virtual journey through the Ferrari factory; and enjoy an array of family-friendly rides and fun-sized kids’ attractions. After roughly 1.5 hours on the road, pull up outside the gigantic Ferrari World complex and head inside to enjoy the attractions at your own pace.

Perhaps start with an exhilarating ride on Formula Rossa, the Formula One-themed coaster that’s one of the park’s best-known attractions. Settle into your capsule and feel the g-force as you rocket up to 170 feet (52 meters) at almost 150 mph (240 kmph) before plunging around the hair-raising chicanes and steep drops. It’s the planet’s fastest coaster, so it’s a serious adrenaline rush! Maybe take a virtual tour of the Ferrari factory in Italy; enter the 4D fantasy world of Speed of Magic; and go giddy on the family-friendly Tyre Twist, a new slant on the turning teacup ride.

Head for the Scuderia Challenge to compete against the world’s best drivers; hurtle around the challenging go-kart track or watch the toddlers have fun on the climbing walls of the Junior Training Camp. When you want to relax, refuel with lunch (own expense) at any of the restaurants or cafes, and browse the stores to pick up Ferrari-branded gifts (own expense) as mementos.

overview: Leave bustling Dubai for the idyllic Musandam Peninsula on this full-day cruise trip. Enjoy the mountain and coastal views as you cross into Oman and head for Khasab on Musandam’s northern coast, known as the ‘Norway of Arabia.’ Then, relax and enjoy the scenery on an unforgettable ‘dhow’ sail boat cruise, drifting by a coastline of rocky peaks, fjord-like inlets and green-blue waters. Look for dolphins, drop anchor at barren Telegraph Island, stop to swim and snorkel, and marvel at the setting over an onboard buffet lunch and unlimited sodas.
highlights: Full-day Musandam Peninsula dhow cruise trip from Dubai, with a local guide
Soak up views of golden beaches and mountains on a drive into Oman

Arabia'

expect: After a morning pickup from your Dubai hotel, travel by air-conditioned minivan along the UAE coast to the Musandam Peninsula. Part of Oman — yet divided from it by the UAE — this mountainous region lies on the northeast tip of the Arabian Peninsula. Cross the Omani border and drive to Khasab, Musandam’s small and pretty mountain-backed capital. Here, board a traditional Omani dhow and set sail around the spectacular Musandam coastline, known as the 'Norway of Arabia' for its soaring fjords, barren mountains and turquoise waters.

Enjoy complimentary soda, mineral water and fresh fruit on board, and soak up the magnificent scenery from the sunny or shaded deck areas. Keep a lookout for pods of playful dolphins in the waters around the bow. Musandam’s seas are home to significant populations of humpback and bottlenose dolphins, so there’s a good chance of sightings. Around midway through your cruise, drop anchor off the rocky islet of Telegraph Island. Take a swim or use the provided snorkeling equipment to waft through the bright blue waters among schools of angelfish, wrasse and parrot fish. Then, dig into a delicious Arabic-style buffet lunch on board. Savor dishes such as grilled chicken, pasta salads, flatbreads and hummus (chickpea dip) as you bask in the setting and sunshine. In the afternoon, enjoy more time to swim, snorkel or kick back on deck. Then, relish the last views of the coastline as you sail back to Khasab.
After your 6-hour cruise, bid farewell to your skipper and crew, and drive back to Dubai, where your trip ends at your hotel.

title.en: Day Tour to the East Coast - Orient Express

overview: Venture into the beautiful UAE desert and learn about traditional mountain life on this Hatta Dubai 4x4 day trip. Leave Dubai by air-conditioned 4x4 and pass serene desert landscapes, rolling dunes and the craggy Hajar Mountains of the UAE-Oman border on route to Hatta. Visit Hatta Heritage Village, a restored mountain village where mud-and-stone houses and craft displays showcase life here centuries ago. After a packed lunch, visit the striking rock formations of Camel Rock and Fossil Rock, embedded with aeons-old marine fossils, on your way back to Dubai.
highlights: Day trip from Dubai to the northeastern tip of the United Arab Emirates
Admire the staggering Hajar Mountains between the capital and the coast
Discover the desert towns and coastal villages of Al Ahaid and Dibba Al-Hisn
Visit Al Bithnah Fort and Al Badiyah Mosque, the oldest mosque in the UAE
Shop for Arabian rugs, pottery, antiques and more at the Masafi market
Transport by comfortable air-conditioned coach
expect: Hop aboard your comfortable, 4x4 at your central Dubai hotel in the morning. Settle into the air-conditioned interior and with your driver-guide at the wheel, set off on your journey through the UAE’S stark desert landscapes.
Head toward the UAE-Oman border and Hatta, an old trading settlement with a historical fort and rock pools, nestled high in the craggy Hajar Mountains.

Watch as the terrain shifts from open plains to dunes and rocky mountain slopes, and after roughly two hours on the road, arrive at Hatta Heritage Village. A recreation of an old mountain hamlet dating back to before the 20th century, the complex comprises dwellings and buildings built from mud, palm leaves, reeds and stone — just as they were in bygone days.

Head inside with your guide to stroll around the simple houses, mosques and watchtowers and see the displays of weaponry, handicrafts and traditional dress that showcase what life was like here until the mid-1900s.
See Hatta Fort as you learn more about the region’s history, and then climb back inside your 4x4 to venture deeper into the desert.

Take a break to enjoy a packed lunch of a burger and soda, and then continue to Jebel Maleihah, otherwise known as Fossil Rock. This large rocky outcrop rears sharply from the sands and gets its nickname from the many ancient marine fossils embedded in its slopes. Hop out to look for these swirling, aeons-old fossils — imprints of shells and tiny marine creatures that lived on the ocean floor when the Arabian Peninsula was covered by the sea millions of years ago.
Then, make your way to nearby Camel Rock. Take snaps of this unmissable desert rock formation that resembles a camel, and then return to Dubai where your day trip ends at your hotel.

overview: Discover the delightful, mountain-backed city of Al Ain on this full-day trip from Dubai. Called the Garden City for its lush parks, this picturesque city lies beneath the Hajar Mountains near the Oman border and offers up forts and attractions that recall a bygone age. See the Bronze Age ruins at the archaeological park and explore two museums, the former royal palace and charming Al Jahili fort. Finish with stops at the warm springs, the camel market and the oasis to see the falaj (water channels) that irrigate the palms.

expect: After pickup from your central Dubai hotel, settle into your air-conditioned coach. Then, sit back and absorb the desert views as you head to Al Ain. Dubbed the Garden City for its green parks, this attractive city is fringed by the Hajar Mountains near the Oman border. After approximately 1.5 hours on the road, pull up at the Hili Archaeological Park outside the city, home to the remains of a Bronze Age settlement that dates to the 3rd millennium century BC.

Inspect the relics of mud-brick houses and tombs, and then continue into Al Ain proper to visit the Al Ain National Museum, where many more of the park's relics are on show. View the age-old pottery and tools, and chart Al Ain’s recent history in the days before the discovery of oil. Then, head for Al Jahili Fort, one of the UAE’s oldest buildings. Head inside to explore this postcard-pretty fort and learn how it was built in 1891 to protect the city’s palm groves.

Next, stretch your legs around Al Ain oasis to see the simple-but-ingenious falaj channels. Snaking overground between the palms, take a closer look at the channels and learn they have been used to irrigate local plantations for thousands for years. Following lunch (own expense), visit the Sheikh Zayed Palace Museum. The former home of late UAE president, His Highness Sheikh Zayed, this restored palace sits among palms and magnolia trees, and comprises official rooms and collections that belong to the ruling family. Having explored here, visit the hot springs below Jebel Hafeet, the mountain that towers over the city. Perhaps paddle in the waters, and then stop at the bustling Camel Market. See the camels and mingle with the locals as they inspect and haggle over the prized livestock. Your tour then concludes with a hotel drop-off in Dubai.

overview: Marvel at the space-age architecture of Abu Dhabi on a full-day trip from Dubai. With an informative guide, travel to the UAE’s shimmering capital by air-conditioned coach and ogle its line-up of soaring skyscrapers, eye-popping hotels and boundary-pushing leisure parks. View the futuristic, eco-friendly city of Masdar; explore Yas Island, home to Ferrari World Abu Dhabi; and see top sights such as the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque as you learn about Abu Dhabi’s transformation from fishing port to space-age city in a few short decades.

expect: Depart your central Dubai hotel in the morning. Meet your guide, settle into your comfortable, air-conditioned coach and travel through the desert, past Jebel Ali port, to Abu Dhabi, the UAE’s capital.

Along the way, hear fascinating facts about Abu Dhabi’s rapid development following the oil boom of the 1950s and 1960s. Before then, the city was little more than a small fishing port, with a handful of buildings, harborside and a defensive fort. Learn how the discovery of oil changed everything at lightning speed, and how recently, Abu Dhabi’s rulers have taken their cue from glamorous Dubai, investing heavily in futuristic architecture and leisure attractions.

Start with a visit to Masdar City: a multi-billion dollar eco-city under construction on the edges of Abu Dhabi. The energy-efficient city is powered mostly by solar panels and composed of cube-like buildings that make it look like it’s landed from a sci-fi movie. Take in the views of the city, due to be finished in 2525, before continuing to Yas Island, an artificial island given over to luxury hotels and leisure parks. Marvel at the spectacular Yas Viceroy Hotel with its eye-popping LED canopy, and stop for photos of the Yas Marina F1 circuit.

Take in gleaming Ferrari World Abu Dhabi, the world’s first Ferrari-designed motorsport park. While your tour doesn’t include time to experience the park’s rides, visit the gift store to shop for Ferrari-themed souvenirs (own expense).

Refuel with lunch (own expense) on Yas Island, and afterward, visit Saadiyat Island, another man-made islet that showcases Abu Dhabi’s contemporary art and cultural achievements. Pose for photos at the UAE Pavilion — an acclaimed sustainable building — and explore the visitor center at Manarat Al Saadiyat, where videos and scale models illustrate the Abu Dhabi of the future.
Snap pictures of the glittering Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Abu Dhabi’s best-known mosque, before returning to Dubai, where your day trip ends at your hotel.

The white sandy beaches and the generous promenade make for a great walk and place to observe the local life.

You will then visit the Heritage Village, a rich cultural representation of the Emirates' past. It is a re-creation of an Emirati village and showcases the Bedouin lifestyle, with campfires brewing up the famous Arabic tea at the Bedouin tents, camels, Arabian horses and goats on display. There are several artisan exhibits showcasing the local arts such as weaving or glass blowing, falconry demonstrations and a small traditional souk where you can find souvenirs such as hand made soap, silver jewellery and traditional clothing. Your last stop is the Orient Art Gallery, which showcases traditional and contemporary art of the UAE, and is reflective of the rising art scene in this region. Feel free to browse for a while before you head back to Dubai.

overview: Discover the UAE’s pretty garden town of Al-Ain on a private day trip from Dubai! Framed by the craggy Hajar Mountains and lush gardens, Al-Ain is one of the country’s oldest towns, with a Bronze Age past. Traveling by air-conditioned minibus with your private guide, cruise through the desert to this lovely town, and visit its colorful camel market and interesting Sheik Zayed Palace Museum, once home to the UAE’s late Sheikh Zayed. Finish at the fascinating Hili Archaeological Park to view its Bronze Age tomb and other antiquities.
highlights: Full-day private tour of Al-Ain with transport from Dubai
Learn all about the UAE’s Garden City from a knowledgeable private guide
Visit Sheik Zayed Palace Museum to explore the former UAE president’s home

expect: Start your experience with a pickup from your central Dubai hotel. Meet your guide, settle into your private air-conditioned vehicle, and set out on your day trip to Al-Ain, often known as the Garden City.

As you travel, hear about the history of this picturesque town from your guide. One of the oldest towns in the UAE, Al-Ain lies at the foot of the Hajar Mountains and is known for its lush gardens and tree-lined boulevards. While you chat with your guide, let them know if there’s anything you want to see more of. Your tour is private, so the itinerary can tailored to suit you.

After roughly 1.5 hours on the road, drink in the sight of the craggy mountain peaks, and pass Al-Ain’s green parks on route to your first stop — the Sheik Zayed Palace Museum. The former home of the UAE’s late first president, His Highness Sheikh Zayed, this museum gives you an absorbing insight into the still-revered ruler. Step inside to view the beautiful interiors, artworks, meeting rooms and gardens, and learn more about the great man and his life.

Get a taste of old-time Arabia on a stroll around the enclosures of Al-Ain’s camel market. See the braying camels and take in the fascinating sight of the hawkers’ as they negotiate over their valuable animals.

Stop for a delicious lunch in town (own expense), and then visit the Hili Archeological Park, where Bronze Age relics thought to date back 4,000 years have been excavated. Stroll around to see the remnants of a Bronze Age tomb, decorated with carvings, and witness other relics of the aeons-old settlements uncovered here.
Afterward, return to Dubai, where your day trip ends back at your hotel.

City’

expect: A long drive from the city of Dubai to Al-ain you will be seeing the great dessert surrounding the city towards the Hajar Mountains, it’s a perfect time to sit back and relax while your guide explains about your day’s activities After a drive of around an hour and half you will reach Al-ain the Green city of UAE, also known as the city of Gardens, it’s a great pleasure to see the town in desert with lots of greenery around. Al-ain is the birth place of the ruler Sheik Zayed with his patronage and efforts Al-ain became the Green city of U.A.E. The first stop will be at Sheik Zayed palace Museum where you can experience how the humble ruler lived in the past and spent his life. The next stop will be Al Jahili fort, the picturesque Al Jahili Fort is one of the UAE’s most historic buildings. It was erected in 1891 to defend the city and protect precious palm groves. An Al Ain landmark, the fort has been carefully restored and now houses a permanent exhibition of the work of British adventurer Sir Wilfred Continue to Camel Market of Al-ain, this is the last souk of its kind in the UAE, it’s an excellent opportunity to see camels up close and see and hear traders discussing the price and merits of their animals. There are some excellent photo opportunities, but be careful where you point your lens and always ask permission first.

People will try to sell you a tour around the pens, but feel free to walk around on your own. In the livestock section, watch locals arrive in pickups laden with goats and sheep, ready to do some hard bargaining.

After a lunch break ( at your own expenses) You will be driven to Al Hili Archaeological park which is situated about 12km from Al-ain city, the place is the treasure of country’s Bronze metal, you can explore the Al Hili tombs, The tombs of Al Hili settlement were used for collective burials over centuries and their funerary goods give valuable evidence of life in the oasis.
You tour will be ending by evening around 5pm to drive you back from Al-ain to Dubai.

title.en: Private Tour: UAE East Coast Day Trip from Dubai

overview: Experience the UAE of olden times on this private day trip to the country’s scenic east coast from Dubai. With a private guide, drive through the desert and Hajar Mountains to this gorgeous chunk of coast, dotted with old-time villages, forts and idyllic beaches. Stroll along the waterfronts of the fishing towns of Dibba and Khor Fakkan; visit the old stone-and-mud Al Badiyah Mosque; admire picture-perfect Fujairah Fort, and stop to swim or sunbathe at a beautiful beach. Finish with a visit to colorful Masafi Market before returning to Dubai.
highlights: Private day trip to the UAE East Coast from Dubai
Visit the fishing village of Dibba, near the border of Oman
Make the most of some free time to sunbathe or swim in the Indian Ocean
Stop for photos at Badiyah Mosque and Fujairah Fort while learning about their history
Stroll around the chic coastal town of Khor Fakkan, and visit the Friday Market in
Masafi
Enjoy personalized attention from a knowledgeable, private guide
expect: After pickup from your central Dubai hotel, travel by air-conditioned minivan through the desert and craggy Hajar Mountains to the UAE’s east coast.

On route, enjoy the views and hear from your guide how this scenic shoreline attracts visitors who swap Dubai’s bustle for its peaceful harbor towns, old forts and pristine beaches. As you travel, let your guide know if there’s anything you want to see more of. Since your tour is private, your itinerary can be customized around you. Arrive in Dibba, a picturesque port town, and stroll along the waterfront past fisherman gathering their catches. Then, follow the beautiful coastal roads to either a public beach or the Sandy Beach Hotel and Resort —just select your preference on the day. If you opt for the Sandy Beach hotel, pay the entrance fee and enjoy the sands, sea and swimming pool, together with a delicious included lunch buffet.

After your relaxation time, reconvene with your guide and continue to Badiyah, home to one of the UAE’s oldest mosques. Stop to visit the beautifully simple, mud-and-stone place of worship, admiring its low domes and wooden doors as you hear how it’s believed to date back to the 1400s.
Continue to the port town of Khor Fakkan to stroll along its garden-lined waterfront, and then drive through the village of Murbah to Fujairah.

Here, visit Fujairah Fort, a splendidly restored fort perched above old Fujairah. Admire its round and square towers as your guide explains how the fort was constructed in 1670, before being badly damaged by a British bombardment in the early 20th century. After taking photos here, finish your east coast explorations at the Masafi Friday Market. Despite its name, this bustling outdoor market is open seven days a week and offers rich pickings for visitors.
Scour the stalls for handicrafts such as rugs, pottery and jewelry, and then drive back to Dubai, where your tour ends with a hotel drop-off.

title.en: Luxury Dinner in the Desert Experience from Dubai

overview: Treat yourself to a VIP dinner-and-desert experience with this private, luxury 7-hour adventure from Dubai. Venture into the desert in a plush Range Rover 4x4, and take a thrilling wildlife drive through the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve to look for rare Arabian oryx and other desert species. Then, after watching a stunning falconry display, ride a camel to a romantic, lamp-lit desert sanctuary and enjoy a private, gourmet 6-course dinner under the stars. Upgrade your experience to a private Range Rover and enjoy a private wildlife-spotting drive before dinner.
highlights: Private dinner in the desert experience with transport from Dubai
Travel through Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve by a Range Rover
Stop in at a dining site around an oasis in the grounds of a royal residence
Watch a falconry display as the sun starts to set on the sand dunes
Enjoy a 6-course dinner in a private sanctuary within the grounds
Samples of local specialities
Upgrade you luxury desert experience to include a private Range Rover
expect: Begin your luxury experience at your central Dubai hotel. Hop inside your comfortable, air- conditioned Range Rover 4x4, and sit back and relax as you cruise into the surrounding desert. As you travel, listen as your guide shares tales about Dubai’s history and some of the traditional desert customs that still lie at the heart of Emirati culture. After a while, arrive at the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, a protected area established to help preserve the desert’s indigenous wildlife and ecosystem.

Set off on a wildlife drive around the dunes and plains. Watch for animals such as the rare Arabian oryx, and more common species such as gazelle and desert monitors, and learn about the flora and other features of this natural wilderness.

Afterward, leave your Range Rover to experience a spectacular falconry display. Learn how the falcon is the UAE’s national bird and watch transfixed as these magnificent birds soar through the air to collect lures before returning to their gloved handlers. If you wish, take the opportunity to get up-close to the falcons and have a souvenir photo taken. Then, as the sun sets, take a camel ride to a private and romantic desert dinner sanctuary softly lit by flame torches and lanterns.

Take a seat at your private table and absorb the setting over your 6-course dinner, cooked nearby by a private chef. As the stars twinkle above, savor gourmet Middle Eastern and Asian-inspired dishes such as spiced lamb cooked underground, grilled salmon and an exquisite dessert assortment. See the Itinerary for a sample menu. Between courses, enjoy some desert activities such as getting a henna tattoo, watching a belly dancing show or taking the opportunity to try a shisha (Arabic water pipe) if you wish. With your meal finished, return to Dubai by Range Rover, ending your evening with a hotel drop-off.

title.en: 1- or 2-Night Self-Drive 4x4 Desert and Camping Adventure from Dubai

overview: Venture deep into Arabia’s deserts on a self-drive expedition from Dubai. Select a 1- or 2-night tour, and drive a Jeep Wrangler in convoy to the Big Red, Pink Rock and Fossil Rock ridge-dunes. Get driving tips and burn some rubber before camping overnight. The next day, enjoy a dune drive and return to Dubai, or, on the 2-night trip, continue to the Liwa Desert, home to the Arabian Peninsula’s tallest dunes. Conquer the dunes and camp overnight before returning to Dubai. Daily barbecue dinners and breakfasts included.
highlights: 1- or 2-night self-drive 4x4 desert and dune bash trip from Dubai
Drive a Jeep Wrangler into the desert expanses of the UAE in a guided convoy
Learn to drive off-road and conquer rugged terrain and dunes
Climb the famous ridges of Fossil Rock and Pink Rock, and ascend the dunes of Big
Red
Visit the Liwa Desert, where steep dunes fringe the Rub al Khali or 'Empty Quarter' (if option selected)
Camp each night in the desert, with a BBQ dinner under the stars and breakfast each morning
All driving and camping gear included, and no desert driving experience required
expect: Day 1: Dubai – Desert Driving - Desert Camp (D)

Begin your 1- or 2-night trip with a hotel pickup and collect your air-conditioned Jeep. Get a safety briefing, driving instructions and a walkie-talkie, and drive your 4x4 along the tarmac roads into the desert. After deflating your tires for off-road driving, leave the tarmac and cross the undulating sands to Pink Rock dune. Learn the desert-driving essentials here, swapping driving with your passengers as you wish. Watch for camels and desert wildlife, and make photo stops on route to Big Red, a beautiful area of high dunes. Have fun negotiating the sands, and then thrill as you tackle the higher, rock-crowned Fossil Rock before driving through more dunes to a desert campsite.
Set up your tent, and enjoy a barbecue dinner under the stars as you chat over your exploits. Overnight: Desert Camp
Day 2: Desert Camp – Dubai (B), or Liwa (B, L, D)

After an early campfire breakfast, pack up camp. Then, if you’ve chosen the 1-night tour, enjoying an exhilarating morning dune bash before ending your tour in Dubai. For the 2-night tour, follow breakfast with a 4-hour drive to Liwa, a remote region in the Rub al Khali or 'Empty Quarter' that’s home to the Arabian Peninsula’s highest dunes. After a buffet lunch at a hotel, take an exhilarating dune drive. Master more advanced maneuvers and feel your adrenaline race as you slip and spin around the slopes. Make camp in Liwa and enjoy a barbecue dinner under a spectacular canopy of stars before settling in your tent. Overnight: Desert Camp in Liwa
Day 3: Liwa – Dubai (B)
After breakfast, leave camp and drive back to Dubai, where your tour ends around noon.
