title.en: Private Overnight Safari: Sandboarding, Camel Ride, BBQ Dinner and Belly Dancing

overview: Enjoy outdoor adventure among the dunes on this private 2-day Dubai desert experience. Travel by camelback at a local camel farm and ride over the dunes during an exciting sand-boarding session. Watch the sun set on the horizon at your desert campsite, then enjoy traditional entertainments including henna tattooing and folk dance. Savor a delicious barbecue dinner and relax with a pipe as belly-dancers perform around the campfire. Afterward, drift off to sleep as the stars twinkle overhead. Upgrade your tour to include a 30-minute or 1-hour quad biking session.
highlights: Overnight Dubai desert experience with a private guide and transport by 4x4
Ride a camel on a visit to a camel farm in the heart of the desert
Glide down the desert sand dunes during a sandboarding session
Savor a BBQ dinner at a desert campsite while watching a folk- and belly-dancing show
Sleep under the stars at the campsite before returning to Dubai the next day
Upgrade to include a 30- or 60-minute quad biking experience halfway through Day 1
expect: Day 1: Dubai – Dubai Desert (D) After a pickup from your centrally located Dubai hotel, relax in your private air-conditioned 4X4 vehicle as you head to the desert that surrounds the city. Admire views of the barren yet enchanting landscape on the way, and listen to your private guide’s tales about the region and its fascinating geology. First stop on your desert rendezvous is a traditional camel farm to see herds of the magnificent humpbacked herbivores. Show off your balance skills on a camel ride around the enclosures, and learn about the different types of camels that are commonly seen in the desert around Dubai.

Continue by 4x4 across the desert plains and try your hand at a popular local pastime: sandboarding! Learn to master the art of 'surfing on sand' and race your friends and fellow travelers down the sand dunes during in an adrenaline-rushing experience. If you have upgraded to include a 30- or 60-minute quad-biking experience, enjoy this after sandboarding. Listen to a safety briefing, and then take to the dunes as you follow a local guide around the desert canyons and valleys.

Then, travel with your guide to a campsite, nestled deep in the desert where you will join other guests sharing the same experience. Take a seat outside to watch your show as the sun sets over the craggy canyons and sun-baked plains, and settle in for the evening’s entertainment. Get a henna tattoo design on your hands or feet, watch a traditional tanoura folk dance, and feast on a delicious barbecue dinner. See the Itinerary for a sample menu. After dinner, smoke a shisha (Arabic water pipe), if you wish, and watch a live belly-dance performance around the campfire. Relax under a canopy of twinkling stars and enjoy an experience that could be straight out of One Thousand and One Nights! When you are ready to leave the partying, make your way to your tent — complete with comfortable mattress, pillows and sleeping bag — within the camp. Settle in and enjoy sleeping overnight in the heart of the desert!

Overnight: Arabic camp in the desert Day 2: Dubai Desert – Dubai (B) Relax over breakfast, meet your private driver and then travel back to Dubai. Your overnight experience finishes with a drop-off at your hotel.

title.en: 4x4 Dubai Desert Safari with Dune Bashing, Sandboarding, Camel Riding and BBQ Dinner

overview: Discover the beauty and customs of the desert on a 6-hour Dubai desert safari. Leave Dubai in a comfortable 4x4 with a guide, and enjoy an exciting mix of traditional and modern desert adventures. Ride a camel, surf a sandboard down the Dubai sand dunes and relax at a desert campsite as the sun sets. Get a henna tattoo, watch a ‘tanoura’ folk dance and top off your trip with a scrumptious barbecue dinner and exotic belly dancing show under the stars as you sit around the campfire.
highlights: Take in the views of the golden desert landscape as a guide drives Visit a camel farm in the heart of the desert and ride a camel Enjoy an exhilarating sandboarding experience down the desert dunes
Get a henna tattoo on your hands or feet, if you wish

expect: Meet your guide at your central Dubai hotel and board a comfortable air-conditioned 4x4. Enjoy the views as you leave the city skyscrapers behind and set off on your 6-hour Dubai desert tour.

Gaze at the Dubai sands and hear all about the desert’s ecology and its history as you travel. After arriving at a traditional camel farm, see the hardy herbivores up close and take a memorable camel ride within the enclosures. Discover more about the different species of camels used in the region, and then return to your 4x4 to continue your desert journey. Afterward, arrive at a desert campsite nestled amid the Dubai sand dunes and leave your 4x4 again to sample the thrills of sandboarding.

Following a safety briefing, practice riding a sandboard with tips from your guide. Once you’re confident, race your fellow travelers down the drifting dune slopes. Then settle inside the camp as the sun sinks below the dunes and plains. If you wish, ask one of the henna artists to paint a tattoo on one of your hands or feet. Watch a colorful tanoura folk dance and savor a succulent barbecue dinner. Dig into typical Arabian dishes such as hummus (chickpea dip) and marinated chicken. (See below for a sample menu.) As a finale, puff on a shisha (Arabic water pipe) if you wish, and watch a brilliant belly-dance performance around the campfire. Upgrade to an Exclusive Dubai Desert Safari by enjoying the delicious barbecue dinner at your exclusive table with a bottle of sparkling wine and fruit basket.
Soak up the desert setting as the stars light up overhead, and conclude your tour with 4x4 drop-off at your Dubai hotel.

title.en: Dubai Desert 4x4 Safari with Quad Ride, Camel Ride, BBQ Dinner and Belly Dancing

overview: Enjoy an afternoon and evening of desert fun on this 5-hour adventure from Dubai. Traveling by comfortable 4x4, venture to a beautiful desert camp and after Arabic coffee and dates, take off on a thrilling quad bike ride across the sands. Enjoy a camel ride, see some sand art, get a henna tattoo, and finish with a starlit barbecue dinner back at the camp. As you feast on delicious Arabic dishes, watch a sequinned belly dancing show and hypnotic ‘tanoura’ performance, with dancers spinning in time to traditional Emirati music.
highlights: 5-hour 4x4 desert safari with BBQ dinner and quad ride from Dubai
Ride a 4x4 over the dunes as the sun sinks over the desert
Arrive at a Bedouin-style camp and be welcomed with Arabic coffee and dates

expect: After pickup from your central Dubai hotel, relax into your air-conditioned 4x4 and journey into the desert. On route, chat to your guide, who acts as your driver, and hear fascinating stories about Dubai and the desert around you.

Go off road and head into an area of dunes for an exciting dune bash. Hold tight as your 4x4 ploughs up the sandy slopes before skidding and sliding back down. Continue to a beautiful, Bedouin-style desert camp nestled in the heart of the dunes. Hop out of your 4x4 into the torchlit grounds and enjoy a revitalizing Arabic coffee and fresh dates. If you wish, try an aromatic shisha (Arabic water pipe) along with your coffee. Duly refreshed, take off on a 15-minute quad bike ride. Listen to a safety briefing and instructions, pull on a provided helmet, and zip and zoom around the camp and desert terrain. Visit a camel farm and enjoy a short ride on one of these hardy desert animals. Afterward, admire some examples of delicate sand art, and if you wish, get a henna tattoo etched onto your hands or feet.

As darkness falls, return to the camp for a delectable barbecue dinner. Menus may vary, but typical dishes include shawarma (spit-roast meat wraps), Arabic salads and kebabs teamed with complimentary sodas and additional drinks (own expense) from the bar. See the Itinerary for a sample menu.

During your meal, enjoy a glittering belly dance show and watch ‘tanoura’ dancers spin, whirling dervish-style, across the floor, in time to rhythmic Arabian music. Finally, return to Dubai by 4x4 and end your experience with a hotel drop-off.

title.en: Dubai Super Saver: City Sightseeing Tour and Desert Safari

overview: Embark on a desert safari and see Dubai’s highlights with this Dubai Super Saver, combining two popular tours at a discounted price over two successive days. On one day, take an afternoon Dubai city sightseeing tour to discover top Dubai attractions such as the Burj Al-Arab and Gold Souk, and on another day, enjoy an afternoon and evening Dubai desert safari that includes a camel ride, sandboard session, sunset barbecue dinner, belly dancing show and other entertainments. Choose the order you want to take the tours to suit your schedule.
highlights: Combine two best-selling Dubai tours for a discounted price
See top Dubai attractions on your sightseeing tour: Burj Al Arab hotel, Jumeirah
Beach, Al Fahidi Fort and Deira
Venture into the heart of the Arabian Desert on a 4x4 safari
Ride a camel at a Dubai camel farm and try your hand at desert sandboarding
Relax with a barbeque dinner under the starry Arabian sky, with live dancing and music
expect: Dubai City Sightseeing Tour (Afternoon on Day 1 or 2 — your choice):
Begin your 4.5-hour Dubai city tour with an afternoon pickup from your central Dubai hotel. Relax and enjoy the views from your air-conditioned minivan as you set out on your sightseeing.

Admire the glittering Burj Al-Arab hotel rising from a man-made islet off Jumeirah Beach and hear how this iconic, sail-shaped hotel stands an incredible 1,053-foot-high (321-meter) high and offers the ultimate in luxury accommodation.

Snap photos of the hotel and drive along the waterfront into Jumeirah, Dubai’s most desirable residential neighborhood. Continue to the traditional Al Bastakiya quarter and view the wind- tunnel houses and 18th-century Al Fahidi Fort — the city’s oldest building. Cross Dubai Creek to the bustling area of Deira and visit the colorful Spice Souk, where the stalls sell aromatic herbs, foods and spices. Stroll the alleyways with your guide and afterward, dive into the nearby Gold Souk. Enjoy free time to browse the sparkling gold and silver stores before your tour finishes with a hotel drop-off.
4x4 Dubai Desert Safari (Afternoon and Evening on Day 1 or 2 — your choice):

Leave your central Dubai hotel in the afternoon by comfortable 4x4 and relax as you cruise into the surrounding desert. On route, visit a camel farm. View these hardy herbivores in their natural environment, and learn why they make perfect desert transport. Then, if you wish, take a short camel ride around the enclosures.

Continue to an area of high dunes and try some sandboarding — the hottest of desert sports. Get instructions from your guide, grab a provided sandboard, and feel your adrenaline race as you slide down the dunes and race your fellow travelers on the sandy slopes. With your sandboarding over, drive to a desert campsite for dinner. Sit down to a scrumptious barbecue meal as the sun sets and afterward, enjoy the traditional Emirati activities on offer. Watch a swirling tanoura folk dance and choose to get a henna tattoo and smoke a shisha (Arabian water pipe). Lastly, sit around the campfire and watch a colorful belly dancing show before your drive back to your Dubai hotel.

Hop inside a comfortable 4x4 and cruise to the towering orange-red dunes of the Lahbab region. Enjoy an adrenaline-pumping dune drive as your driver skids, slides and ploughs up and down the slopes. Then, after a sunset photo stop, arrive at a Bedouin-style camp and enjoy a camel ride, sandboarding and other desert activities. highlights: 5-hour 4x4 dune bashing and desert camp experience from Dubai
Enjoy a thrilling 4x4 ride over the red dunes of the Lahbab region

expect: Start your experience with a 4x4 pickup from your central Dubai hotel and zoom into the desert around the city. On route, listen as your guide shares information about the region and how Dubai rose from a fishing port into a cosmopolitan, wealthy city on the back of the discovery of oil during the 1950s and 1960s.

See the light brown sands gradually shift into vivid orange and pink hues, and watch as the flat expanses crinkle up into undulating dunes all in a kaleidoscope of deep reds and golds. Head off road into an area of bright red dunes known as the Lahbab region. Have your camera ready to capture what look like giant beanbags of sands, and then hold tight you cruise toward the highest slopes.

Then, feel the adrenaline race as your 4x4 ploughs up the dunes before sliding and slipping back down the slopes, churning up billowing clouds of sands in the process. Afterward, take pictures of the sunset from the dunes before driving on to a Bedouin-style camp hidden in the middle of the desert. Enter the torchlit camp and settle inside a cushion- strewn tent. Savor some fresh Arabian coffee and dates, and smoke a shisha (water pipe) if you wish.

Then, take your pick of desert activities. Perhaps take a camel ride, surf the dunes on a sandboard and get a henna tattoo painted on your hands or feet. If you fancy upping the pace, take an exciting buggy ride (additional cost) over the sands. As dusk falls, dig into a scrumptious barbecue dinner of dishes such as kebabs, hummus and salads accompanied by sodas and mineral water, and additional drinks (own expense) from the bar. While you eat, enjoy a colorful belly dancing show and tanoura performance, where fast-spinning dancers whirl across the stage along with a captivating fire dance show. Finally, return to Dubai by 4x4, where your experience concludes with a hotel drop-off.

Soar along the Jumeirah coastline past the skyscrapers of downtown Dubai and gaze down at The Palm, the artificial island that resembles the shape of a palm tree, as your pilot points out the most notable landmarks.

Swoop toward the Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest building, and absorb the aerial views of the sail-shaped Burj Al-Arab hotel, rising from an island off Jumeirah Beach. title.en: Private Tour: Dubai Falconry Experience with Wildlife Drive and Optional Breakfast

overview: Try your hand at falconry on a private tour within the Dubai desert. Set out in the early morning to the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, located amid the emirates' vast sand dunes. Learn about the region and its wildlife, then enjoy a hands-on falconry experience with guidance from a professional trainer. Feed a bird of prey and marvel as it returns to your gloved hand, and discover a variety of training techniques ranging from age-old tactics to remote-controlled drones. Upgrade with an optional post-falconry breakfast at Al Maha Desert Resort.
highlights: 5-hour private falconry session with 4x4 transport from Dubai
Travel to Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, a beautiful nature reserve
Explore the reserve to look for Arabian oryx and other desert animals

expect: Start with an early morning pickup from your Dubai hotel by air-conditioned 4x4 vehicle, and chat to your private guide as your travel to the desert retreat. Gaze out at the scenery, and gain insight into the the country's passion for falconry from your guide. The practice originated from Bedouin tribes who used falcons to hunt desert animals so they could add meat to their nomadic diet. After roughly 40 minutes, arrive at the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, the national park where your falconry experience takes place. First, take a wildlife-spotting drive through the reserve as you hear about the animals and plants that thrive in the unforgiving environment. Look out for indigenous animals such as Arabian oryx, gazelle, hares and geckos.

Then, meet one of the reserve’s qualified falconers to start your interactive experience with a number of falcons, kestrels and other birds of prey, all from an exclusive family collection. With practical tips from your trainer, take an active part in the birds’ daily training session. Wear a falconry glove and get the birds to fly from your fist to collect food and return to your hand.

During your private 1.5- to 2-hour session, see demonstrations of ancient and modern training techniques, such as the the use of remote control drones, and watch the birds as they soar through the sky and dive for bait. Marvel at their speed and listen as the falconer describes their innate hunting instincts. When your session finishes, travel back to your hotel where your tour ends Tour with Breakfast:

Want to make your morning more special? Complement your desert experience with a breakfast fit for an Arabian king. Before your Dubai hotel drop-off, travel to the luxurious Al Maha Desert Resort for breakfast in the hotel’s renowned Al Diwaan restaurant. Choose to sit inside or outside, and feast from an international buffet that features classic western treats such as eggs Royale alongside spiced scrambled eggs and even fillet steak. Fruit juice, coffee and tea are included. Morning cocktails of mimosas and bloody marys are available at your own expense. See a sample menu in the Itinerary.

title.en: Private 4x4 Hatta Day Trip to Heritage Village and Desert Rocks

overview: Fall in love with the UAE’s beautiful desert and mountains on this private day trip by 4x4 from Dubai. With a private guide, cruise past the desert plains and dunes in a comfortable 4x4. Absorb the tranquility and head into the rugged Hajar Mountains to Hatta Heritage Village, a recreation of an old mountain village with mud-and-stone houses, craft displays and more. Learn about bygone life here, and after a packed lunch, look for millennia-old desert rock fossils and see Camel Rock, a rocky outcrop that resembles a camel’s head.
highlights: Private day trip to Hatta Heritage Village and the UAE desert by 4x4 jeep
Travel with a friendly private guide from Dubai to the towering mountains of Al-Hajar
Discover the UAE’s contrasting scenery with enchanting city, desert and mountain vistas

expect: Meet your guide at your central Dubai hotel, relax into your air-conditioned 4x4, and start your full-day trip into the desert and Hajar Mountains.

Travel eastward through the desert interior, and on route, let your guide know if there are any sights that you want to see more of during your trip. Your tour is private, so the schedule can be tailored to your wishes.

As you head toward Hatta, watch as the landscapes change from open expanses to dunes, and the rocky foothills of the Hajar Mountains. Hear from your guide about Hatta itself, an old trading settlement known for its historical fort and rock pools nestled into the mountain slopes.

After roughly two hours, arrive at Hatta Heritage Village and explore it by foot. A recreation of an old mountain hamlet as it would have been before the UAE’s oil boom, the village is composed of dwellings and buildings built from mud, palm leaves, reeds and stone — just as in the past.
Head inside with your guide to view the simple houses, mosques and watchtowers, as well as the displays of weaponry, handicrafts and traditional dress that detail life here before the mid- 1900s.

Afterward, stop to view Hatta Fort before driving deeper into the desert. Stop to enjoy a boxed lunch of a burger and soda, and continue to Jebel Maleihah, nicknamed Fossil Rock. This rocky outcrop looms from the sands and is named after the ancient marine fossils embedded in its slopes.
Hop out to see the intricate fossils — imprints of shells and marine creatures that lived here when the Arabian Peninsula lay under the sea millennia ago.
Lastly, stop for photos of nearby Camel Rock — a bizarre formation that resembles a camel’s head—and then finish your day trip with a hotel drop-off.

Learn to brake, accelerate and steer before you make the most of this high performance automatic on the course. This tour offers travelers a truly unique experience that's perfect for speedsters and thrill-seekers.
highlights: Driving Audi TT experience from Dubai
Perfect for adventure-seekers and adrenaline junkies
expect: The all new Audi TT 45 TFSI Coupe Quattro is totally revamped from it’s predecessor, with a 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbocharged engine delivering 230 bhp under the right foot. Lighter and lower, it takes pocket rocket handling to the next level, as it hugs the tarmac while evoking confidence through superb handling and progressive steering. The little brother of the Audi R8 super car, the TT appeals to anyone seeking a rush of adrenaline coupled to a precise driving experience. All enhanced by a futuristic and full customization instrument cluster to cater for the needs and preferences of the driver. The new TT raises the bar in more ways than one when it comes to track action – now it’s your turn to experience it!

Once you arrive in the Race and Drive Centre, you will be given a full briefing by our professional race instructors, and then off to the race circuit where you will strapped into a Audi TT with an instructor to guide you. Following your drive, the instructor will take the wheel and propel both of you at thrilling race speeds around the track.

Instructors turn of High Speed Passenger Ride for 2 laps
Instructor assisted driving at a 2.46km club circuit behind the wheel of a Audi TT 2.0

title.en: Desert Safari From Dubai: Including Buffet Dinner and Live Entertainment

overview: Experience the evocative sights, sounds and traditions of the desert on a 6-hour tour from Dubai. Hop inside an air-conditioned 4x4 and zoom deep into the desert outside the city. Kick-start your adventures with an exhilarating ride through the towering red-sand dunes. Capture a brilliant desert sunset on camera, and visit a welcoming Bedouin-style desert camp for an Arabic coffee, camel ride and dinner. As the stars light up above, dig into a sizzling barbecue and buffet dinner, accompanied by complimentary sodas and a scintillating belly-dancing show.
highlights: 6-hour desert trip from Dubai, including dune-bash, starlit dinner and live entertainment
Hold tight on an exciting 4x4 ride up and down high red-sand dunes
Stop to snap photos of a glowing desert sunset
Visit a beautiful Bedouin-style camp nestled in the sands
Sip on Arabic coffee and enjoy a short camel ride
Feast on a BBQ and buffet dinner under the stars, with complimentary sodas
Enjoy a belly-dancing show and learn your own belly dancing moves
expect: From the moment your safari guide will pick you up from you place of stay; right through to the drop off point, you will feel that the whole experience is beyond perfection. You will enjoy sitting in one of the luxurious air-conditioned SUV that will take you for a great ride throw the big reds of Dubai, and feel the skill and the control over the soft dunes from your safari guide who will make your day unforgettable. After taking a several photos during the amazing sunset you will continue toward the camp composite and it’s there where you will get to meet the friendly camels and you will be dedicated for a short ride that will amaze you.

Your safari guide will indicate your reserved seats and there you will relax and sip some Arabic coffee with cardamom Wright before you will be called for a delicious barbecue and buffet dinner that will enriched your appetite. This when the gorgeous belly dancer will come to entertain you and tantalize you with her moves, she might call you or invite you to take part by practicing some belly dance as well .
As your adventurous day ends up you will be joining again your SUV heading back toward you hotel with many memories that you can share with your friends.

title.en: Dubai Shore Excursion: Private 4x4 Desert Adventure Safari

overview: Explore Dubai's vast Arabian desert while visiting Dubai port. Set out with an experienced guide on a private safari-style adventure, traversing undulating sand hills in a 4x4 vehicle, riding camels across the sparse terrain, and testing your ability to balance on a board while literally surfing down dunes. Afterward, enjoy a barbecue dinner and a belly dancing performance in a desert village, smoke a shisha pipe and return from your shore excursion with a temporary henna tattoo.
highlights: Private Dubai desert shore excursion with an expert local driver/guide
Feel the excitement on a 4x4 drive through the Dubai desert
Enjoy a camel ride and try sandboarding down the desert dunes
Visit a desert campsite and get a henna tattoo while watching a tanoura show
Feast on a barbeque dinner and enjoy a belly-dancing performance
expect: Meet your guide outside the cruise terminal in the Port of Dubai, and then travel toward the Dubai desert in your air-conditioned 4WD vehicle. Relax as your private driver/guide chats about Dubai and its surroundings, and take in views of the desert scenery that abounds. Your first stop is a traditional camel farm to learn how these magnificent creatures are able to survive in the harsh desert landscape. Back in your 4x4, continue traveling across the Dubai desert and travel to the campsite.

Once you reach the desert campsite, hop on board a camel for a short ride across the desert. Next get ready for your adrenaline-rushing experience: sandboarding! Show off your balancing skills while mastering the art of surfing on sand, and race other people in your group down the dunes.

Relax in the campsite as dusk falls, and then start your evening’s entertainment! Get a henna tattoo on your hands or feet, if you wish, and then watch a traditional folk dance performance called tanoura. Feast on a delicious barbecue dinner with soft drinks as the sun sets over the Dubai desert, and then enjoy your evening’s grand finale – a live belly-dancing performance around the campfire. Sit back and enjoy the show while smoking a shisha (Arabic water pipe), if you wish, and then travel back to the Port of Dubai.

Worry-free Shore Excursion: We will ensure your timely return to the Port of Dubai for this activity. In the rare event your ship has departed, we will arrange for transportation to the next port-of call. If your ship is delayed and you are unable to attend this activity, your money will be refunded. title.en: Private 4x4 Adventurer Safari Including Sandboarding

overview: Love sport? Try a spot of sandboarding in the desert dunes around Dubai on this private 4-hour 4x4 experience. Hop aboard your comfortable 4x4 with your private guide, and head deep into the desert interior to a region of beautiful, rolling dunes. Then, with one-to-one instructions from your guide, learn to surf down the slopes on a provided sandboard. Develop your skills and speed, and move up to higher slopes as you wish. Upgrade to enjoy a 30-minute or 1-hour quad biking ride as part of your sporty exploits.
highlights: 4-hour private sandboarding safari by 4x4 from Dubai
Head to some of the biggest and best sand dunes in the Dubai desert
Ride and slide down the slopes under the expert eye of your private guide
Escape from the city to try one of the most popular desert sports
Upgrade to enjoy a 30-minute or 60-minute quad biking session
Travel by comfortable, air-conditioned 4x4
Enjoy personalized attention from your guide on this private tour
expect: Start your 4-hour sandboarding experience with a pickup from your central Dubai hotel. Meet your private guide, hop inside your comfortable 4x4 and set off on your journey into the UAE desert.
Enjoy the views of the passing desert landscapes, and watch as they gradually turn from wide- open plains to small and ever larger orange dunes.

As you travel, hear fun facts about sandboarding from your guide and learn how it’s one of the most popular desert sports in the UAE. After a while, arrive in an area of gorgeous golden dunes and head for some slopes that are ideal for learning to sandboard. Hop out of your vehicle and, after a safety briefing, get your supplied sandboard and instructions on how to balance on it and steer it from your guide. Then, with your guide watching and offering tips, try slipping and surfing down the slopes. Gain in confidence as you practice and move up to some steeper, longer slopes as you wish — you’re in control of the pace and progress you want to make. If you’ve upgraded to include a quad biking session, finish your sandboarding and hop onto your rugged desert vehicle. Listen to a safety briefing and driving instructions, and thrill as you zip over the sands.
Afterward, return to Dubai by 4x4, where your experience ends with a drop-off at your hotel.

title.en: First-Time Indoor Skydiving Experience in Dubai

overview: Want to try skydiving but too nervous? Then, experience all the fun of a free fall minus the fear on this indoor skydiving session in Dubai. Head inside a flagship indoor center, put on your flying suit and helmet, and with an expert instructor at hand, feel the thrill as you’re whipped up into the air in a wind tunnel. Savor the sensation as you’re held aloft by the currents, and relish the wonderful feeling of weightlessness. Your experience includes two 1-minute flying sessions: longer than the average tandem skydive.
highlights: Indoor skydiving experience in Dubai
Make use of a flight suit, goggles, ear plugs and helmet
Get a full safety briefing and training session from an expert instructor
Soar upwards in a safe indoor wind tunnel to simulate the free-falling sensation
Float and twist on the airstream and thrill as you defy gravity
Enjoy two unforgettable 1-minute flights, suspended around three meters above the ground
expect: Travel independently to the indoor skydiving center in Dubai and don your provided flight suit, helmet and goggles in the locker room.

The indoor diving center uses state-of-the-art wind tunnel technology to make your flight possible, including two giant fans that create an airstream of up to 185 miles per hour (300 kilometers per hour) to keep you aloft.
Meet your friendly and highly trained flight instructor, and get a safety briefing and instructions on what to do during your flight, including hand signals and the best body positions to adopt.

Once you’re ready, enter the wind tunnel with your instructor and feel the thrill as you’re instantly lifted to between 10 to 13 feet (three or four meters) in the air. Savor the feeling of weightlessness, and as your confidence builds, turn and move in the air with your instructor standing below, just as you would during a real-world free fall in the sky. It’s an incredible sensation and the nearest thing to flying you can experience, apart from outdoor skydiving.
Enjoy two 1-minute flying sessions with a short break in between: more ‘flight’ time that you get during an average tandem skydiving leap.
After your two unforgettable sessions, change back into your clothes and, if you wish, buy souvenir photos or a video (own expense) as a keepsake. Your experience finishes when you leave the center.

title.en: Jebel Jais Mountain 4x4 Day Trip from Dubai Including Lunch

overview: Ride a 4x4 up Jebel Jais, the UAE’s highest mountain, on a scenic full-day trip from Dubai. Board a comfortable 4x4 chauffeured by an expert driver, and drive into the rocky Jebel Harim range that straddles the border with Oman. Then, cruise up the twisting mountain roads past sleepy villages, ravines and terraced slopes before going off- road to Jebel Jais’ summit. Soak up the incredible mountaintop views and head back down to enjoy lunch at a local restaurant. Numbers are limited to six per vehicle for a more personalized atmosphere.

expect: Begin your small-group day trip with a pickup from your centrally located Dubai hotel. Hop inside your 6-seater 4x4 with your driver, who doubles as your guide, and travel north along the UAE’s coast. Enjoy glimpses of the Persian Gulf and the Jebel Harim mountains in the distance. Formed more than 70 million years ago, this rugged range straddles the UAE and Oman border and includes the UAE’s highest peak — Jebel Jais — at 6, 266 feet (1,190 meters) high.

Enjoy the complimentary onboard drinks and light snacks, and after roughly 1.5 hours, arrive at the base of the mountain. Then, enjoy the views as your 4x4 traces the roads that wind up the mountainside. Pass ancient villages, terraced farms and palm groves as you ascend and watch for goats on the craggy slopes. Feel the temperature drop as you ascend through the foothills and ravines, and stop to take snaps of the awesome views. Near the summit, feel the thrill as your 4x4 goes off-road for the last part of the climb. Bump along the unmade track and at the top, step outside to experience the spectacular scenery. Marvel at the jaw-dropping mountain views stretching far into Oman and in all directions. Listen as your guide points out the main peaks and drink in the overwhelming stillness and natural beauty around you.

Return to your 4x4 and descend the mountain. Then, visit a local restaurant for a succulent lunch of typical Arabian dishes such as grilled meat, hummus and salads, accompanied by complimentary non-alcoholic drinks. After lunch, drive back to Dubai where your tour finishes with a drop-off at your hotel.

Continue into Jumeirah, one of Dubai’s upmarket residential areas, and admire Jumeirah Mosque before driving to the Al Bastakiya quarter, home to a cluster of restored courtyard houses with traditional wind-towers. Stretch your legs around the narrow lanes as your guide explains how the towers capture and circulate cool breezes, and hear how the area was first settled by pearl and textile merchants in the 1900s.

Stay on in Bastakiya to visit Dubai Museum, housed in the 18th-century Al Fahidi Fort. Head inside with your guide to chart Dubai’s history through the interesting exhibits and learn about life here before the oil boom.

Next, board a traditional abra water taxi to sail across Dubai Creek, the central waterway, to the Deira district. Absorb the city views from the water and breathe in the heady aromas around the colorful spice and herb stalls of the traditional Spice Souk. From here, head to the Gold Souk and browse for bargains at the myriad of shops glittering with gold, platinum and gemstones. Then, when the time comes, your tour ends with a drop-off at Dubai International Airport.

From here, you will walk to Al Ahmadia School, which was the first school in the Emirate and played a key role in the history of education. Many members of the ruling family have studied there.

From here, you will cross the creek to the other side to explore the charming Bastakiya village, with its narrow lanes, and houses with tall chimney-like structures called wind towers. overview: Experience the wildlife and beauty of the desert by night on this 5- hour private experience from Dubai. With a private driver, roam the dunes and use the night-vision binoculars and headlights to spot nocturnal animals foraging in the darkness. Then, relax at a royal desert retreat with a delicious 2-course dinner and stargazing session with an astronomer guide. In summer, upgrade to enjoy your wildlife drive in a plush Range Rover.

expect: In the late afternoon, depart your central Dubai hotel by private, air-conditioned minivan. With your private driver-guide at the wheel, cruise into the desert that surrounds Dubai. After roughly an hour, pull up at a royal retreat among the dunes. Owned by members of the local royal family, the camp sits in the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, a protected area dedicated to helping preserve the desert ecosystem. On arrival, swap your minivan for your private wildlife-watching vehicle, with a private driver. Hop inside a vintage 1950s Land Rover, or if you’ve upgraded (summer only), settle into a luxurious Range Rover. Then, as darkness falls, drive around the twilit dunes and plains in search of wildlife. As you roam, learn how the reserve is home to Arabian oryx, gazelles, hares and many other creatures. Hear how both nocturnal and even some daylight animals use the cool and cover of evening to feed and forage.

Soak in the stillness and watch the headlight beams to detect any movement in the sands. Use the provided night-vision binoculars to zoom in on any animals you spot. After your approximately 1.5-hour drive, savor a 2-course dinner at the torchlit camp. Smoke a shisha (Arabic water pipe) if you wish, and with tips from an astronomer guide, scan the star-spangled sky to learn about the constellations above. Later, return to Dubai, where your tour finishes with a hotel drop-off.

title.en: Private Tour: Sharjah City Highlights

overview: Discover the must-see sights of Sharjah, the neighboring emirate to Dubai, on this 4.5-hour private tour.

With your own private guide beside you, leave Dubai by air- conditioned minivan, and delve into the intriguing city of Sharjah, with its quaint Old Town of souks, museums and heritage attractions. Admire the gleaming King Faisal Mosque; visit the restored, 17th-century Sharjah Fort and fascinating Sharjah Heritage Museum; and delve into the colorful stalls of Al Arsah Souk and Al Markazi Souk as your guide sheds light on Sharjah’s history and rich cultural heritage.

expect: After pickup from your central Dubai hotel, travel by air-conditioned minivan into the neighboring emirate of Sharjah for your private 4.5-hour tour. On route, hear about the history of the city of Sharjah, the emirate’s namesake capital, set on the shores of the Arabian Gulf and nicknamed the Pearl of the Gulf. Learn how the city boasts a lovely, restored Old Town complete with a fort, heritage areas, souks and museums. As you travel, let your guide know if there’s anything you want to see more of during your visit. Your tour is private so your itinerary can be tailored to your interests. Stop first at the imperious King Faisal Mosque, Sharjah’s largest mosque. Stroll around the exterior to admire the domes and minarets as your guide explains how the mosque was a gift from Saudi Arabia’s king in 1987.

Continue to Sharjah Fort (Al Hisn Fort) to explore this beautifully restored 19th-century outpost. Hear how it was once home to the Al Qasimi family — Sharjah’s rulers — and head inside to view the traditional Emirati architecture and artifacts. After a visit to Sharjah Heritage Museum to learn more about Sharjah’s fascinating past, visit two of the city’s most popular souks.

Hear about the importance of the markets to Emirati life, and head to Souk Al Arsah. Browse the stalls hawking everything from pashminas and khanjars (daggers) to herbs and spices, and hear how the souk originated when Persian traders sold their wares here over 50 years ago. Continue to the Al Markazi Souk, where the shops sell gold, jewelry, silk and carpets. Get some free time to buy souvenirs (own expense) before finishing your tour with a drop-off at your Dubai hotel.

Return to the elevator and whizz up another 23 floors to Level 148 — the world’s highest observatory at 1,820 feet (555 meters) high. Your experience ends when you leave the Burj Khalifa.

title.en: Wild Wadi Water Park Entrance Ticket

overview: Throw yourself into the aquatic fun of Wild Wadi Water Park in Dubai with this all-day entrance ticket. Head inside and enjoy the rides and pools at leisure — there’s something for all ages and tastes. Plunge down the terrifying Jumeirah Sceirah, drift along the lazy river, take a spin on Tantrum Alley, and ride a tube into the fast-spinning bowl of Burj Surj. Children will adore the splashy fun of the Dhow and Lagoon; and when you want a break, relax at the wide range of restaurants, shops and cafes
highlights: Full-day entrance ticket to Wild Wadi Water Park in Dubai
Enjoy the 30 water slides and attractions as you please for as long you wish

expect: Travel independently to the Wild Wadi Water Park in Dubai’s Jumeirah district. Show your ticket, stroll through the gates and enjoy the park’s 30 or so aquatic adventures at your own pace.

Take your pick from the white-knuckle and gentler attractions, and the array of fun pools. The water park is themed around Juha, the much-loved hero of Arabian legend, and there are rides for all ages, from the tiniest toddlers to adrenaline-loving grown-ups. Perhaps float along the lazy river, or let the kids loose on the water sprays, slides and dumping buckets of the colorful Dhow and Lagoon.

Fancy taking things up a gear? Waft down Flood River to conquer its sudden waves and foaming river rapids, or catch the surf at Breaker’s Bay, the Middle East’s biggest wave pool, where 5-foot (1.5-meter) waves come at you from every direction! For serious thrills, tackle the heart-pounding heights of Jumeirah Sceirah. Climb the 105-foot (32-meter) tower, board a capsule and then scream out loud as you plummet back down at 50mph (80kmph).

Alternatively, go giddy on the rotating Tantrum Alley, ride a tube down into the high-speed spiralling bowl of the Burj Surj; or shoot 49 feet (15 meters) into the sky on the powerful Master Blasters.

When you need a breather, relax over lunch, snacks and drinks (all at own expense) at the restaurants or cafes. Dig into tasty pizzas, pastas or barbecue fare or refuel with a smoothie, juice, soda or ice cream — there’s a food outlet for every taste. Perhaps finish at the gift, toy and aqua-wear stores to buy mementos of your day. When you’ve had your fill of fun, leave the park when you wish. Your ticket is valid up till closing time on the day.

Surrounded by 10 million liters of water, experience the thrill of being in such close proximity to thousands of aquatic animals including sharks and rays. From there, your Explorer journey continues in the Underwater Zoo with a submersible simulator which takes you on a virtual adventure with a sea turtle narrator as you swim amongst several sea creatures including dugongs and whale sharks. Next, watch a film demonstrating how passionately the Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo team care for 30,000 aquatic animals on a daily basis. Head down to water level and step aboard the glass-bottom boat, drift out over the surface of the aquarium and watch thousands of animals swim below your feet, all while learning interesting, fun facts from your guide with an added opportunity to feed the fish below.

Continue into the Underwater Zoo which leads you through three ecological zones – the rainforest, rocky shore and living ocean bringing you up close with penguins, piranhas, giant spider crabs, giant water rats, sea stars, otters, sea jellies and plenty more. A stop not to be missed on the Underwater Zoo journey is the home of King Croc, one of the world’s largest reptiles. He measures over 5 metres long, weighs over 750 Kg and shares his Australian habitat with his long term companion, Queen Croc. Cap off your Underwater Zoo experience with a visit to the “UAE Night Creatures” exhibit featuring an amazing diversity of Arabian wildlife including snakes, insects, lizards, small mammals & amphibians.

expect: This tour takes you on a visit of the three attractions that you should not miss being in Dubai. The first stop will be at the astonishing garden, called 'Dubai Miracle Garden', which continues to enthrall visitors with millions of blooming flowers in various artistic designs & outstanding structures during the winter months.. The Garden comprises more than 45 million flowers spread across the 72000 sqm site, most of which, are planted for the first time in the Gulf region.

The traditional flowerbeds are arranged in arches and flowerbeds forming various shapes and patterns, with topiary-style displays, apart from blooms that take the shape of stars, hearts, igloos, pyramids and many more. Dubai Miracle Garden gained world recognition by the Guinness Book of World Records as the ‘Largest Vertical Garden’. After spending 45 minutes in the Miracle Gardens, the next stop is at the Butterfly Garden consisting of 9 domes, with each dome being filled with various colors, sizes and species of lovely colorful butterflies (10,000 live butterfly species). Also, between the domes, there are alluring butterfly museum and a butterfly flower park.

The domes are climate-controlled and give butterflies a comfortable environment. The last stop will be at the Global Village arena, which is the largest seasonal cultural extravaganza in the region that offers visitors an amazing array of festivals, shopping and entertainment in an open-air theme park. This entertainment and shopping destination is open from November through to April and hosts over 70 participating countries presented in over 36 pavilions, with more than 50 fun rides and 26 restaurants offering cuisines from around the world.

title.en: Yas Waterworld Entrance Ticket Including Transport from Dubai

overview: Dive into the aquatic fun of Yas Waterworld on this day trip from Dubai, with round-trip transfers included. Jump on an air-conditioned coach and travel to Yas Island off Abu Dhabi to enjoy the rides, slides and pools of the all-action water park as you wish. Take a high-speed spin on the Dawwama tornado, plunge down Jebel Drop, conquer the rapids of Falcon’s Falaj water coaster and let the little ones loose at the wave pools and water playgrounds. Ideal for all the family, from thrill-seeking adults to fun-loving youngsters.
highlights: Entrance ticket to Yas Waterworld on Abu Dhabi’s Yas Island, with round-trip transfers from Dubai
Enjoy the rides, slides and coasters at one of the UAE’s biggest water parks
Choose from thrill-level themed rides for everyone, from adrenaline junkies to tamer types and tots
Ride the world’s most exhilarating 6-person tornado, the Dawwama
Plunge down the super-steep Jebel Drop, ride coasters and drift down a lazy river
Enjoy family-friendly rides, kids’ pools and an interactive treasure hunt for pearls
Take a break from the fun at the many restaurants and shops
expect: Depart your central Dubai hotel by air-conditioned coach and enjoy the views as you drive south through the desert to Abu Dhabi. Along the way, listen as your guide reveals fun facts about Yas Waterworld. Located on artificial Yas Island off the coast of Abu Dhabi, this aquatic extravaganza offers excitement aplenty with some 43 rides, slides and other splashy adventures.

Hear how the attractions are handily grouped into four thrill levels, from Adrenaline Rush for white-knuckle fiends, to the slightly less scary Exciting Adventures and the tamer Moving and Grooving and Young Fun categories ideal for youngsters.

After roughly an hour, pull up at Waterworld, show your entry ticket, and enjoy ample time to enjoy the attractions at your own pace. If you’re up for serious thrills, head for the Dawwama, the planet’s biggest 6-person tornado waterslide, or tackle the Bandit Bomber, an 1,800-foot (550-meter) coaster with incredible water and laser effects. Alternatively, ride the Bubble’s Barrel, the world’s largest surfable sheet wave; zoom around the Falcon’s Falaj water coaster, or race your friends on the multi-lane Sebag.

For family fun, meanwhile, drift along the lazy river or hunt for treasure courtesy of the Pearlmaster adventure. There’s plenty for kids, too. Watch them slip, slide and splash at the fun Yehal zone or let them loose on the water jets of the Marah Fortress. Whenever you need a rest, refuel with pastas, pizzas or other treats at the restaurants (own expense) and scout out goodies at the gift and watersports stores.
Later, rejoin your coach and return to Dubai where your day trip finishes with a hotel drop- off.

title.en: Dubai City Sightseeing Tour with Burj Khalifa 'At The Top' Visit and Lunch

overview: Discover Dubai’s highlights in one outing on this full-day sightseeing tour, including lunch and the Burj Khalifa ‘At the Top’ observatory. With an informative guide, ride The Palm Monorail to the spectacular The Lost Chambers Aquarium at the Atlantis, The Palm; visit fascinating Dubai Museum; ride an ‘abra’ water taxi across Dubai Creek to the Spice and Gold Souks; and more. Finally, admire the 360-degree views from the Burj Khalifa 124th floor and a dazzling Dubai Fountain Show. Your tour includes a delicious 4-course lunch midway through your sightseeing.
highlights: Full-day sightseeing tour of Dubai with a local guide
Ride the monorail to Atlantis The Palm, to visit the Ambassador Lagoon
Ogle the views from Burj Khalifa’s ‘At the Top’ observation deck
Explore Dubai Museum, and haggle for souvenirs at the Gold Souk and Spice Souk
Take photos of the Burj Al-Arab hotel and ride across Dubai Creek by abra
Savor a 4-course Arabian lunch with bottled water
expect: Depart your central Dubai hotel by air-conditioned coach or minivan and travel to The Palm, Jumeirah — the artificial island shaped like a palm tree.

Ride the state-of-the-art Palm Monorail to the gigantic Atlantis, The Palm hotel, and visit The Lost Chambers (own expense): the hotel’s spectacular aquarium themed around the mythical lost city of Atlantis. With your guide, make your way to the showpiece: the vast Ambassador Lagoon that’s home to 65,000 marine animals.

Ogle the exotic fish and marine creatures in the lagoon and then enjoy free time to look around at your own pace. Afterward, stop for photos at the sail-shaped Burj Al-Arab hotel before driving to Dubai Museum, set in the 18th-century Al-Fahidi Fort in the old Bastakiya quarter.
Enjoy a guided tour, charting Dubai’s history through the artifacts and models as your guide sheds light on the city’s beginnings and fast-paced growth.

Next, break for a delicious, 4-course lunch at a local restaurant. Feast on dishes such as hummus and chicken biryani (mixed rice and meat), accompanied by mineral water and with additional drinks available to buy. See the Itinerary for a sample menu. Ride a traditional abra across Dubai Creek and explore the colorful Spice Souk. Next, dive into the glittering Gold Souk and get tips from your guide as you haggle for great-value gold and jewelry.

Continue to downtown Dubai and visit the Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest building at 2,772 feet (828 meters) high. Ride the high-speed elevator to the ‘At the Top’ observatory on the 124th floor and drink in the panoramic, bird’s-eye views over the city. Back at ground level, stroll to the nearby Burj Khalifa Lake and experience the early evening Dubai Fountain Show. Watch transfixed as the water jets and cascades light up in a rainbow of incandescent colors and dance in time to classical, pop and Arabic music. End your tour here so you can enjoy the evening attractions of the area, or choose to finish your day out with a hotel drop-off.

overview: Let your child explore their creativity and independence on a visit to Dubai’s KidZania, a replica kids’ city of fun role-playing adventures. Head into the kid- sized city with your child and watch as they play-act real-life professions such as being a pilot, chef, police officer, beautician, journalist or other jobs, learning real-life skills as they go. As they work, they earn ‘kidZos’ money to spend at KidZania’s shops and establishments, giving them a taste of grown-up life. A safe, entertaining and educational role-playing experience for kids aged between four and 16 years.
highlights: Adult and child entrance ticket to KidZania in Dubai
Explore KidZania’s scaled-down city of 80 role-playing adventures at replica academies, shops and other establishments
Let your child train as a firefighter, police officer, pilot, TV newscaster, DJ or other professional
Kids earn ‘kidZos’ for their work and can spend them at KidZania’s establishments or save them at the bank
Safe, fun and educational environment to inspire your child’s confidence and creativity
Teaches children essential life skills, including team work, communication and independence
Role-playing activities available for kids aged four to 16 years
expect: Travel independently to KidZania in Dubai, show your ticket and head inside. Then, let your youngster enjoy the kid-sized world of fun and role-playing at leisure. Stroll around the replica streets and let your child choose from over 80 role-playing experiences at the city’s academies, shops and establishments. There’s everything from a scaled-down hospital and fire station to an airport, theater, restaurants and more, so they can play out being a pilot, firefighter, radio DJ, chef, surgeon, newscaster or other role, all guided by trained supervisors.

As your child tackles the professions, they earn kidZos — KidZania’s currency — to spend at KidZania stores or play areas, or save for future visits. On their first KidZania visit, a child can open a personal savings account at the KidZania bank. They can then save their kidZos and receive a debit card to be used at the city's ATMs.

Parents can explore KidZania with their child and watch them role-play from outside the establishment. If your child is over 120cms in height, you can leave them to enjoy KidZania as you relax in the parents lounge, with TV, Internet access and a café. For younger siblings, there’s a toddler-friendly play zone to keep them happy and occupied. Please note: Adults must be accompanied by at least one child to enter KidZania. Children above 120cms in height can be left alone inside KidZania. However, in this case, an adult or guardian (17+) must be present at the KidZania entrance to check them in. Children under 120cms in height must be accompanied by an adult/guardian (17+) at all times inside KidZania.

overview: Enjoy a full day of fun and rides with a Platinum Power Pass ticket to Dubai’s SEGA Republic theme park. Located at Dubai Mall, this incredible indoor park is packed with entertainments for all ages. Avoid the entrance lines with your pre-booked ticket, and enjoy up to 16 exciting attractions and 170-plus games. Thrill on exhilarating rides such as Snowboard Mania and the steep-dropping Sonic Hopper; test your skills on cutting-edge virtual and arcade games; compete for prizes, and more. Your 1-day Platinum Power Pass includes AED 200 game credit.
highlights: Platinum Power Pass 1-day entry ticket to the SEGA Republic indoor theme park at
Dubai Mall
Avoid the main lines and enjoy two levels of fun, rides and games for all the family
Experience SEGA-themed rides including Sonic Hopper and the spinning Xyclone
Battle the virtual dead and ride a rollercoaster on the virtual, simulator and arcade games
Play a host of redemption games to win great prizes
Receive 200 AED game credit with your Platinum Power Pass
Perfect for families with kids of all ages
expect: Book your Platinum Power Pass ticket and make your way to SEGA Republic at Dubai Mall, near Reel Cinemas. Visit the counters at the main entrance, collect your pass and head inside to enjoy the rides, games and fun.

Feel the Rush If you're a true adrenaline seeker, enjoy the motion-simulator games such as Sonic Hopper - a heart-stoppingly steep drop ride with a twist: the hopping motion of SEGA character Sonic the Hedgehog! Plus, enjoy the 360-degree sensation of the Storm-G as you twist, turn and spin down sharp mountain bends in a high-speed, futuristic bobsled race. One top recent attraction is the Middle East’s longest and fastest Giant Slider: two superfast slides designed to get your blood racing. Then there's Rope Rush: an intricate network of steel ropes called combi-cables that provides a thrilling, but completely safe balancing and adventure course for all the family.

For Adventure-Seekers Love adventure? Then, feel the thrill of what, for many, is the highlight of SEGA Republic: Spin Gear. A fast-spinning coaster alive with dazzling visual and sound effects, it's a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Other motion-simulated virtual attractions include Wild Wing, Wild Jungle and Let’s Go Jungle! Energy-enthusiasts can also try Xyclone, a thrill-packed ride that sees 16 seated riders rotate at high speed and tilt at up to 360 degree. And there's also Robotnik, a scary, swinging ride with 360-degree flipping motion that will satisfy the most demanding adrenaline junkies. Put Yourself to the Test Test your skills and compete to win on the latest trend-setting simulation games based on real-world sports. Halfpipe Canyon is a high-tech snowboarding half-pipe that lets you throttle up and down a 23-foot (7-meter) incline at speeds of up to 25 miles (40 kilometers) per hour, scoring points for performing various spins. Plus, why not ride the Racer Bumper Cars? Enjoy a high-speed game of strategy and nerve as you try and avoid the fast, oncoming vehicles!

Play to Win! SEGA Republic features one of the region’s largest arrays of redemption games, a huge selection of merchandise for all ages, and an appealing mix of carnival games and classic arcade games.

For Younger Guests Adding to the family indoor theme park experience, children can have fun at the spacious Soft Play Area, filled with customized activities that will keep them entertained for hours.
For the Little Ones SEGA Republic also boasts its own toddlers play area, featuring slides, a ball pool, building blocks and lots more.

overview: Experience jaw-dropping views over Dubai with entry to the Burj Khalifa ‘At the Top’ observatory, including hotel pickup. See the landmarks close-up using the powerful telescopes, learn fascinating facts about the tower via the interactive exhibits, order souvenir photos (own expense), and take your leave independently to continue exploring downtown Dubai.

Ride the high-speed elevators to the ‘At the Top’ deck, on the 124th floor

Leave independently and explore surrounding, downtown Dubai as you wish

expect: You'll have the world’s fastest elevator as your chariot – you’ll ascend at a whopping 64 kilometers per hour, or 40 miles per hour –, and you’ll arrive at the 124th floor for a visit to the sunny observation deck. From the Burj Khalifa’s observatory, you’ll be able to look down upon a full 360 degrees of turquoise, tan, and silver city. The observation deck also features interactive exhibits on the tower’s architecture and technology, and viewing telescopes you can use.

Pictures to remember the trip by are important for a stand-out experience like mounting the world’s tallest tower, so as you enter, a photographer will take your picture. If you like it, you can purchase it as you exit. There are also some photographers available on the 124th floor; for any photos taken, you’ll be able to collect a ticket from the photographers, then review them and purchase the ones you love before leaving!

overview: Discover the best of Dubai on a half-day Dubai sightseeing tour with an expert guide. Traveling by comfortable coach or minivan, take in Dubai’s top landmarks as you absorb the cosmopolitan atmosphere. Snap photos of the Burj Al-Arab, the sail-shaped hotel on its own artificial island; venture into the traditional Al Bastakiya district, ride an ‘abra’ water taxi across Dubai Creek, and much more. Sign off with a visit to the Deira Spice Souk and free time to explore the brilliant Gold Souk. Dubai sightseeing at its easiest and best!

expect: Start your 4.5-hour Dubai city tour with a pickup from your central Dubai hotel. Hop inside your air-conditioned coach or minivan and travel to your first stop. Hear how the hotel’s sail-shaped design has made it one of Dubai’s signature sights and learn how it stands at a remarkable 1,053-foot (321-meter) high.
Drive through exclusive Jumeirah, one of Dubai’s most upscale residential districts. See the plush villas and hotels, and continue into the old Al Bastakiya quarter to get a glimpse of Dubai’s past.

Navigate past mudbrick courtyards and houses with wind towers that circulate the cooling breeze. See the 18th-century Al Fahidi Fort, the city’s oldest building and home to Dubai Museum, as your guide tells you about its historical fortifications. Board an abra and enjoy the views as you cross Dubai Creek. Arrive in Deira and stroll with your guide around the vibrant Spice Souk. Scan the colorful stalls of perfumed spices, herbs and sweets, and then head for the nearby Gold Souk.
Enjoy free time to explore the gold and jewelry stores, and finish your tour with a hotel drop- off.

expect: Leave your central Dubai hotel by air-conditioned coach with your guide, who doubles as your driver. Then, enjoy the views as you travel to the Burj Al-Arab, the sail-shaped hotel situated just off the coast at Jumeirah. Marvel at the distinctive, sail-shaped design of the 1,053-foot-high (321 meter) hotel, and go inside for a scrumptious afternoon tea. Settle inside the restaurant-lounge in the Burj Al-Arab’s magnificent atrium, and enjoy a sweet and savory selection of dainty sandwiches, pastries and scones accompanied by tea or coffee.

Admire the plush, softly lit surroundings and soak up the views from the floor-to-ceiling windows. After your Burj Al-Arab tea, continue by coach to Dubai Marina to admire Jumeirah’s skyscrapers, and pass the high-rises of Sheikh Zayed Road as you drive to Burj al Khalifa, the world’s highest building.

Gaze upward to view the needle-shaped tip of the tower, and with your guide, ride the high- speed elevator to ‘At the Top’, the observation level on the 124th floor. Drink in the heart-pounding views through the vast windows, and walk the full perimeter of the deck to ogle landmarks such as the Palm Jumeirah from every direction. After enjoying the views, return to ground level and stroll to the neighboring Burj Khalifa Lake in time for a Dubai Fountain show. Marvel at the cascades and jets dancing in time to classical and Arabian music, and take snaps as the choreographed fountains light up in a dazzling rainbow of colors.

Your tour ends here when your guide departs. If you wish, continue your evening independently in or around Dubai Mall with restaurant and shopping tips from your guide, or make your own way back to your hotel.

title.en: Abu Dhabi City Sightseeing Tour - The Arabian Jewel

overview: See the sights of Abu Dhabi on a coach tour from Dubai. With a knowledgeable guide, visit the capital city of the United Arab Emirates and visit its impressive monuments, including Sheikh Zayed Mosque, the Zayed Centre — a museum dedicated to the late Sheikh Zayed — and the Abu Dhabi Heritage Village, home to recreated Emirati souks and a Bedouin camp. You’ll learn about Abu Dhabi’s culture, history and attractions from your guide’s expert commentary.
highlights: Full-day Abu Dhabi city tour
Visit Sheikh Zayed Bin Sultan Al-Nahyan Mosque, Abu Dhabi’s grand mosque

expect: After pickup by comfortable coach, leave your centrally located Dubai hotel for Abu Dhabi, the United Arab Emirates capital located approximately 1.5 hours away. Often referred to as the ‘Arabian Jewel,’ Abu Dhabi is renowned for its ostentatious monuments and modern architecture.

The Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque is the first stop on your full-day sightseeing tour. Marvel at the mosque’s sheer size and grandeur, then head inside the impressive monument for a look at its gilded interior, which can accommodate some 40,000 worshipers, making it one of the largest mosques in the world.

Next, it’s a short drive to the Zayed Centre, a museum dedicated to the late Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan, a leader who is said to have shaped the UAE and is affectionately known as the ‘father of the nation.’ Learn from your guide about the Sheikh’s world travels and browse an impressive collection of his personal memorabilia, including photographs, hunting rifles, stuffed lions and cheetahs, and treasured vehicles.

Enjoy a break for lunch (own expense) before a drive to your final stop: the Abu Dhabi Heritage Village. Stroll around this open-air museum, which demonstrates what daily life was like in the city prior to the discovery of oil. Explore recreated Emirati souks and a traditional Bedouin camp complete with goat-hair tents.
Complete your tour of Abu Dhabi with the return to Dubai, passing en route the Dhow Yard where wooden ships are built using time-honored methods. On arrival, you’re dropped off at your hotel.

expect: Dubai serves up a myriad of attractions, from soaring skyscrapers to golden beaches, 21st- century malls and 19th-century wind-towered houses — all testament to its whirlwind transformation from fishing port to one of the world’s wealthiest cities. Just north of Dubai is the lesser-known emirate-city of Sharjah, home to bustling streets, old souks and a splendidly restored Old Town of heritage zones and museums.

With this Super Saver combo, you can explore both Dubai and Sharjah with ease over the course of two days. Enjoy an unlimited 48 hours of travel on the open-top, double-decker City Sightseeing buses that travel around the main attractions of each city. Stay aboard for the full loop of each of the five routes in Dubai or the single route in Sharjah, and as you enjoy panoramic views of the landmarks, hear about their history from the onboard audio commentary, available in 12 languages. Alternatively, hop on and hop off at the designated stops to explore sites of interest on foot. See the Itinerary for a full list of stops and route details.

expect: Begin your Dubai architecture tour with a pickup from your central Dubai hotel. Hop inside your air-conditioned coach or minivan and hear fascinating facts about the space-age city and the futuristic architecture that has become its emblem.

Gaze at the high-rises along the 16-lane Sheikh Zayed Road as you head for Jumeirah, the area of Dubai that has seen the most dramatic architectural development. Admire the stunning Souk Madinat Jumeirah, a lavish recreation of a traditional Arabian marketplace. Then, snap photos of the spectacular Burj Al-Arab hotel. Rising up from an artificial island off the Jumeirah coast, this gleaming building is designed to resemble a billowing sail, and stands at 1,053 feet (321 meters) tall, making it one of the world’s highest hotels.
Continue to the Palm Jumeirah, the palm-tree-shaped island archipelago where rows of exclusive villas and residential complexes stretch along the man-made ‘fronds’ overlooking the Persian Gulf.

Stop to ogle the mammoth Atlantis The Palm, the archipelago’s architectural showpiece, and then head to Ski Dubai, the first indoor ski resort ever built in the Middle East. overview: Explore Sharjah city, the capital of Dubai’s neighboring emirate of Sharjah, on this 4.5-hour tour from Dubai. Sharjah is sometimes called the ‘Pearl of the Gulf,’ and boasts a beautifully restored Old Town of heritage areas, museums and souks. Visit premier sights such as Sharjah Fort, originally built in 1820; see the grandiose King Faisal Mosque; and learn about local life through the ages at the Sharjah Heritage Museum. expect: Your 4.5-hour tour starts with a pickup from your central Dubai hotel and a drive to Sharjah, one of Dubai’s neighboring emirates.

Situated on the shores of the Arabian Gulf, Sharjah is the UAE’s third-biggest city and centers around a restored Old Town that boasts lovely heritage areas, souks and museums. On route, hear about Sharjah’s history from your guide and stop first at Sharjah Fort, a restored fortress-palace originally built in 1820 by Sheikh Sultan bin Saqr Al Qasimi. Head inside to view the courtyard, walls and original Al Kubs tower, and walk through the museum to chart Sharjah’s past, its ruling families and life in the city 200 years ago. Next, continue to the King Faisal Mosque, the largest of the emirate’s 300 mosques. Admire the splendid building and learn how it was built to accommodate 15,000 worshippers. Venture into the heritage area and visit the Sharjah Heritage Museum. Go inside to explore the galleries that offer fascinating insights into different aspects of Sharjah’s heritage, from the local desert to customs and everyday life here, past and present. Afterward, stroll around the Souq Al Arsah, believed to be the UAE’s oldest market and where Persian, Asian and Arab traders once dealt their wares. Browse the stalls selling goodies such as pashminas, coffee pots and jewelry and perhaps snap up souvenirs (own expense) if anything takes your fancy.

Lastly, visit another of Sharjah’s marketplaces, the Souq Al Markazi. Delve inside to peruse everything from designer goods to carpets and traditional Emirati handicrafts. Your tour then concludes with a drop-off at your Dubai hotel.

expect: Begin your 6-hour tour with a pickup from your Dubai hotel. Hop inside your air- conditioned minivan and set off to explore the city’s must-see landmarks. As you travel, hear from your guide how Dubai began life as a humble fishing village before a 20th-century oil boom saw it grow into one of the world’s most dynamic cities.

Explore its roots with a visit to Al Bastakiya, the city’s oldest quarter. See the mud-built wind towers along the narrow lanes, and then chart more of Dubai’s history at the Dubai Museum, housed inside the 18th-century Al Fahidi fort. Stroll around the historical artefacts and trace the city’s lightning-speed development through the interesting scale models, photos and multimedia displays.

Having explored here, take a scenic abra ride across Dubai Creek to Deira’s souks. Absorb the exotic aromas and colors of the Spice Souk and then dive into the Gold Souk, a maze of glittering gold, silver and jewelry outlets.

Admire the gleaming domes and minarets of this magnificent modern mosque, and learn how its design echoes the medieval Fatimid style. Stop for photos of the sail-shaped Burj Al-Arab hotel, and after a tasty lunch near the Dubai Fountains, make your way into Dubai Mall to head up the Burj Khalifa, the world’s highest tower.

Ride a high-speed elevator to the ‘At the Top’ observatory on the 124th floor, and marvel at the incredible, bird’s-eye views. Walk around the full-height glass walls to fully appreciate the panoramas before descending back to ground level.

expect: Experience an exciting desert adventure on this private tour from Dubai. Al Ain is a stunning desert oasis where caravans have stopped off at for many years, and is the first city in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) to have made it onto the famous UNESCO World Heritage Site list.

Today, Al Ain is also known as a “Garden City” and even has a university. As you travel from Dubai to Al Ain you will pass through the spectacular desert landscape. Visit the archaeological site of Hili, which dates back approximately 5,000 years. Together with your tour guide you will drive past Jahili Fort towards the Palace Museum of Al Ain. The palace was the residence of the late ruler Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan from 1927 to the early 1970s. The palace features interesting exhibitions, a collection of family portraits, and provides insight into the private and social life of the family of “Emir”. title.en: Dubai City Tour And Desert Safari With BBQ

overview: Experience three sides of Dubai — the older and new city, and the desert — on this full-day experience.

First, check out top Dubai attractions including skyscraper-ringed Dubai Marina, Dubai Mall and Dubai Aquarium on a city tour. Admire the Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest building, and then head into the beautiful desert. Start the tour from Jumeirah Beach Residence at 11:00 and head towards the marina. The Dubai Marina owes its name to an almost 4-kilometer long manmade canal, where the curving waterside promenades run alongside a large marina and some smaller boat docks as well as numerous restaurants, cafes, boutiques, and a shopping center with approximately 120,000 square feet of retail space.

Take the metro to the Dubai Mall, which is one of the largest shopping malls in the world with 1,200 shops and restaurants. Admire the fascinating underwater world of the aquarium and the underwater zoo. The aquarium in the Dubai Mall holds the Guinness World Record for the largest acrylic panel and is one of the largest aquariums in the world. Drive to Downtown Dubai, the new and modern city center of Dubai. Alongside the shopping center, the Burj Khalifa rises up towards the sky.

At around 15:30 to 15:45 you will experience an exciting journey into the desert. Cross the golden sand dunes to the heart of the desert, where you can enjoy the unforgettable experience of watching the breathtaking sunset over the desert sky.

Upon arrival at the desert camp, you will receive soft drinks, water, tea, or coffee. Enjoy a short camel ride and try out traditional henna body art. At the end of the tour you can then enjoy an Arabic belly dance show and a delicious dinner with barbecue buffet. You will then be dropped off at your hotel around 21:00 to 22:00.

expect: Select your preferred dolphin experience, and travel independently to Dubai’s Atlantis The Palm. Walk to Dolphin Bay in the resort, where three inviting lagoons set the scene for your encounter.
Greet your dolphin trainer, put on your supplied wetsuit or vest, and start your experience with a 15-minute introduction and safety briefing.

Discover how Dolphin Bay, Dubai’s first mammal rescue and rehabilitation centre, is dedicated to education and conservation, and learn about its adorable residents — Pacific bottlenose dolphins. Sip on an included soda or water as you hear about the lives and characteristics of these endearing mammals. Stroll to the lagoon with the rest of your group. Numbers are limited to six people per dolphin at most for the shallow-water interaction, and 10 per dolphin for the deep-water session. The small numbers enable you to enjoy a personalized, 30-minute experience in the water.
Whichever option you choose, it comes with included same-day admission to Dubai’s Aquaventure Waterpark, and 25% off same-day entry to The Lost Chambers Aquarium, both at the Atlantis.

Shallow-Water Experience: Step into the waters beside your trainer and delight as a dolphin swims up close for a one-to-one interaction. Lightly touch the mammal, and watch as the dolphin shows its grace in the water. Your 30-minute experience occurs in shallow water so there’s no need for any swimming.

Deep-Water Experience: Wade into deeper waters with the dolphin trainer, and wait as a dolphin wafts up to you. Look on as the dolphin swims around you, gliding effortlessly through the lagoon’s deep waters. If you wish, pat the dolphin and enjoy a tummy ride, skimming through the water on its back.

overview: Channel your inner superhero as you surge and fly over the sea on a 30-minute flyboarding experience in Dubai. Make your own way to the beach, meet a friendly flyboard instructor, and enjoy the excitement of the world’s coolest watersports craze. Don the special helmet, rise into the air lifted by powerful water jets, and thrill as you spin, roll, and ride high above the waves. No experience necessary: with throttle control and directions relayed by the instructor throughout, this activity is suited to novices and seasoned flyboarders alike.

expect: Make your own way to the Umm Suqeim area near Jumeirah Beach in Dubai and meet your expert instructor at your chosen flyboarding time.

Listen to a safety briefing and instructions on how to operate your flyboard. Similar to a snowboard with two sturdy boots on top, the flyboard is connected by water hoses to a jet ski. Water is then forced through jet nozzles to thrust you up to 49 feet (15 meters) into the air. Riding is relatively easy, and with a little co-ordination, you should be flying successfully within a few minutes! When you’re ready, put on your two-way communication helmet and strap on the boots and board connected to a jet ski waiting offshore. Then, feel your adrenaline rush as the powered jets lift your flyboard and you above the water. Ride the board as your instructor provides instructions through the two-way helmet radio and controls the throttle. Practice tilting your board to steer, and spin, roll and skyrocket higher into the air to soar above the sea — it’s an exhilarating experience. If you’re confident enough, perhaps try advanced maneuvers such as low hovers and donut turns, or dive down into the water, dolphin style.
After around 30 minutes, your flyboarding experience comes to an end when you return to land.

expect: Boarding from the iconic Yas Marina on Yas Island, with the boats conveniently located nearby all the bars & restaurants - our crew will be there to welcome all guests on board, give a safety briefing and offer everybody a cold drink.

Once we exit the marina we will cruise past the Al Raha Beach waterfront developments and head over towards Samaliyah Island, one of the largest privately owned islands within the inshore coastline of Abu Dhabi. The island is part of the UAE Heritage Club and provides unique views to a traditional Emirati village on the beachfront, as well as being home to hundreds of wild gazelles which can be seen roaming around near the mangroves. As we bend the corner at the top of the island we will see the outline of the city's skyline in the distance (depending on visibility), with famous buildings such as the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and the world record leaning Hyatt Capital Gate tower standing out. Cruising back along the inner side of the island this is where most of the gazelles are usually sighted - our captain will be happy to slow down and get up-close to the waterfront where guests will have great photo opportunities with the gazelles in the background. Once the full circle is complete we cruise past the iconic Aldar HQ building (the round building shaped like a coin) and enter the small canals inside the Al Bandar and Al Muneera developments before arriving back at Yas Marina.

overview: See the skyscrapers and sights of Abu Dhabi from a brilliant yellow RIB (rigid-inflatable boat) on this 1-hour cruise. With an expert skipper at the wheel, hold tight and enjoy the thrill and sea spray as your boat bounces across the waters of the Arabian Gulf along Abu Dhabi’s shores. Stop for photos of the high-rises along the palm-lined Corniche; zip by Lulu Island, the Heritage Village and spectacular Emirates Palace hotel; and watch for pods of dolphin in the sea as you listen to the informative live commentary.

expect: Meet your expert skipper at Abu Dhabi Marina, and after a safety briefing, don your provided life vest. Then, climb aboard your state-of-the-art, bright yellow RIB Grasp the clutch rail and feel your anticipation build as the skipper revs the engine and your craft motors away from dock and into the marina bay. Soak in the views of the domes and towers of the monumental Emirates Palace hotel, and then pick up speed as your boat heads out onto the waters of the sparkling Arabian Gulf.

Bounce over the waves and feel the sea spray on your face as you speed along the coast. Pass the Abu Dhabi Heritage Village, a replica of a traditional oasis village, and zoom by the palms and golden sands along the Corniche, Abu Dhabi’s 5-mile (8 kilometer) waterfront. Pause to snap photos of the high-rises that tower above the beaches and listen as your skipper tells tales of Abu Dhabi’s innovative architecture and recent transformation into a glitzy metropolis. Then, watch for pods of dolphins swimming by the boat as you cruise around artificial Lulu Island. Admire the pristine, palm-fringed beaches and ogle the panoramas of Abu Dhabi’s skyline stretched along the horizon.
After roughly one hour, moor back at the marina, where your cruise ends.
